details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to help grow our B2B business by building pipeline and winning new enterprise customers. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys outbound prospecting, navigating complex enterprise deals, and working in a fast-moving environment where you can directly influence how we approach and win new business.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Spend most of your time building your own pipeline targeting Mid-Market and Enterprise companies with $1B+ in annual revenue.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of new opportunities through cold outbound across email, LinkedIn, calls, events, referrals, and creative prospecting channels.
  • Research and map target accounts, identify the right entry points, and multi-thread across 3+ stakeholders rather than relying on a single contact.
  • Own the full sales cycle from first outbound touch to closed-won, including discovery, business case development, negotiation, procurement, and contracting.
  • Identify and develop internal champions, equipping them with the business case, ROI narrative, and materials they need to sell Nebius Academy internally.
  • Navigate complex Enterprise buying processes by identifying champions, economic buyers, decision-makers, and potential blockers early in the cycle.
  • Take ownership of stalled opportunities: understand why deals stop moving and actively create a path forward, rather than relying on standard follow-ups.
  • Work closely with SDRs on account selection, messaging, prospecting tactics, and handoffs, sharing feedback on what converts into real opportunities.
  • Bring senior leadership and founders into strategic opportunities when their involvement can materially increase the likelihood of closing the deal.
  • Bring market and customer insights back to the team to help refine our ICP, positioning, messaging, and Enterprise GTM strategy.
  • Own an annual revenue quota and be accountable for both pipeline creation and closed revenue.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 3+ years of B2B sales experience, including 2+ years in an SDR/BDR role and at least 1 year as an Account Executive.
  • Proven experience working with both Mid-Market and Enterprise accounts, including companies with $1B+ in annual revenue.
  • Experience selling deals with $40K+ annual ACV, with clear ownership of pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Strong outbound background is mandatory — you should be comfortable generating pipeline yourself through cold calls, email, LinkedIn, events, referrals, and other channels.
  • Experience working in a sales organization with a dedicated SDR function and a clear understanding of effective SDR–AE collaboration and handoffs.
  • Proven ability to manage multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles, including champions, decision-makers, economic buyers, procurement, and blockers.
  • Clear evidence of professional growth and increasing responsibility — promotions, expanded territories, larger accounts, higher quotas, leadership responsibilities, or becoming a top performer in a specific area.
  • Proven top performance, supported by quota attainment, revenue/pipeline results, or top-performer recognition.
  • Experience in early- or mid-stage B2B companies; exposure to larger organizations (200+ employees) is a plus.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and hands-on, comfortable working with evolving processes and taking ownership without waiting for perfect structure.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 5000-6000 USD base per month + commissions
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • A diverse team across Europe, the US, Latin America and more.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

 

***TripleTen is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national original, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) is looking for an experienced, hands-on engineering expert to contribute to our masterclass program, starting with a session on Agentic SDLC.

The initial masterclass should demonstrate how a traditional software development lifecycle can be transformed for agentic development. We are looking for a practitioner who can present a concrete before-and-after case and explain how task specifications, code review, QA, release processes, and human oversight changed when AI agents became part of the engineering workflow.

Beyond the initial session, we are interested in building an ongoing collaboration with the expert and potentially involving them in future masterclasses and educational initiatives, depending on program needs and mutual fit.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Deliver technical masterclasses and expert sessions for Nebius Academy, starting with a masterclass on Agentic SDLC.
  • Explain the transition from a traditional software development lifecycle to an agent-enabled development process.
  • Present a concrete before-and-after case, including changes to task specifications, code review, QA, and release practices.
  • Explain how responsibilities are divided between engineers and AI agents, including where human judgment remains essential.
  • Share practical experience with MCP, agent configuration, specifications for agents, and review gates for AI-generated code.
  • Use materials developed by Nebius Academy or co-create and adapt the content together with our team.
  • Collaborate with our curriculum team on the initial masterclass and, where relevant, future expert sessions and educational initiatives.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must have:

  • Current or recent hands-on engineering experience at a well-known, large company that is a leader in its industry.
  • Experience as a Staff Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, Director of Engineering, CTO, or in a comparable senior technical role. A Senior Engineer from a FAANG-like company may also be considered.
  • First-hand experience working with a traditional software development lifecycle before the adoption of AI agents.
  • First-hand experience transforming an engineering process for agentic development, beyond the individual use of tools such as Copilot or Cursor.
  • Ability to explain a concrete before-and-after transformation, including changes to task definition, code review, QA, releases, and engineering responsibilities.
  • Practical experience with MCP, agent configuration, and specifications designed as input for AI agents.
  • Experience defining review rules, checklists, or quality gates for AI-generated code.
  • Ability to discuss real processes and implementation details without being prevented from doing so by NDA restrictions.
  • Continued hands-on involvement in engineering processes, even when working in a leadership or architecture role.

Nice to have:

  • Experience scaling an agentic engineering practice from one engineer to a whole team or organization.
  • Experience overcoming resistance and formalizing a new engineering process across a team.
  • Public speaking, workshop facilitation, mentoring, or internal knowledge-sharing experience.
  • Experience in a high-velocity engineering environment with frequent releases.
  • Experience measuring the impact of agentic development on quality, delivery speed, or other engineering metrics.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• An expert engagement with Nebius Academy, beginning with a masterclass on Agentic SDLC.
  • The opportunity to develop an ongoing collaboration and contribute to future masterclasses and educational initiatives, depending on program needs and mutual fit.
  • An hourly rate of up to USD 200.
  • The option to work with materials already developed by Nebius Academy.
  • The opportunity to co-create or adapt materials together with our curriculum team if you have relevant content and practical cases to contribute.
  • The opportunity to share real-world engineering practices with learners interested in modern AI-enabled software development.

details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.


We're looking for the person who brings an AI and Machine Learning curriculum to life for students: hosts the live sessions, reviews the work, runs the model and system review boards, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside them. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.


This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run live sessions and office hours, give real engineering feedback on student ML deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually built and shipped AI systems in production, has opinions about what a sound ML system looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.


Your audience: An experienced developer or engineer – SWE, data engineer, data analyst, DevOps/SRE, or quant – who wants to move into an adjacent AI/ML role (MLE, AI engineer, MLOps, data scientist) and carry their existing experience across, not start over.


Format: Live sessions, office hours, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 10 to 15 hrs/week.


Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Host live sessions focused on the design of ML systems: agentic architectures, orchestration, evaluation, and reliability of LLM-based systems.
  • Run group office hours, 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
  • Review student projects against rubrics.
  • Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 7+ years of professional ML engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff ML Engineer, AI Engineer, or ML/AI Systems Architect).
  • Has built and shipped AI or ML systems that ran in production in a real company, not just notebooks or side projects.
  • Depth across the AI engineering spine: agentic systems (L3, LangChain/CrewAI/ADK frameworks, orchestration, self-correction), agent reliability and guardrails, MCP; LLM evals (eval harness, LLM-as-judge, hallucination metrics), applied fine-tuning (SFT/LoRA); AI coding tools in the SDLC, LLM observability, A/B experiment design.
  • Can explain why a modeling or architecture decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
  • Strong technical communication: comfortable leading a live session and writing clear, specific review feedback.
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.


Preferred experience:

  • Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
  • Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, ADK) and MCP-based tool integrations.
  • Hands-on ownership of an eval or observability stack in production, not just usage.
  • Work experience at a recognizable company.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy is an educational platform helping business professionals and operations teams stay ahead of the automation curve. We build specialized courses that teach practitioners how to design, implement, and scale AI-powered workflows using modern automation tools — from no-code platforms to enterprise-grade integrations.

Our programs are built for people who work in the real world: operations managers, business analysts, automation engineers, and digital transformation leads. We help them move beyond manual processes and become confident architects of intelligent workflows.

Our mission is to give professionals the knowledge and hands-on skills to automate smarter — and lead their organizations through the shift.

Who are we looking for?

We are building a talent pool of automation practitioners and business technology experts for ongoing roles as Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts in our AI Automation program.

We are looking for specialists across a range of seniority levels and focus areas:

  • Junior (Instructor / Technical Trainer) — 1–3 years designing or supporting automation workflows. Hands-on experience with tools like Zapier, Make, or n8n. Comfortable walking learners through workflows step-by-step with practical, repeatable examples.
  • Mid (Author / Automation Engineer) — 3–6 years implementing automation across business operations. Experience with API integrations, prompt engineering, and RPA platforms. Able to explain automation concepts clearly and debug issues in real time.
  • Senior (Subject Matter Expert / Automation Architect) — 6+ years in automation solution architecture, complex integrations, and large-scale project delivery. Experienced working with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Strong background in business analysis and digital transformation.

A strong candidate doesn't just know automation tools — they use them daily and can teach others to do the same. We look for practitioners who have replaced real manual processes with working solutions, not just people who have studied the theory.

These are Talent Pool positions — we continuously review applications and build our roster of experts. There may not be an immediate opening at the time you apply, but strong candidates will be added to our talent pool and contacted as relevant opportunities arise.

You can join us on a part-time basis (10–15 hours per week) as an instructor leading live sessions and workshops, as a course author creating learning materials, or as a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development.

Apply now — we review applications on an ongoing basis. Our selection process is fully asynchronous and designed to respect your time:

  1. Application Review — we evaluate your profile against our current needs
  2. Async Video Interview — a short self-recorded interview (10–15 minutes max)
  3. Test Assignment — approximately 1 hour to complete
  4. Talent Pool — finalists are added to our active roster of vetted experts
  5. Hiring Manager & Tech Expert Call — once a relevant position opens, we invite you to a live interview with our team
  6. Offer — we extend an offer for a relevant position upon successful completion of the process


Please submit your resume in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
Available Roles

We are building a talent pool of Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts for our AI Automation educational programs. We hire on an ongoing basis across the following specializations:

Most in demand: Make, Zapier, n8n, AI-powered workflow automation, API integrations Also relevant: Power Automate, UiPath, RPA platforms, prompt engineering for automation

Depending on your expertise, you may:

  • Deliver live workshops and training sessions
  • Create educational content, assessments, and project-based learning materials
  • Design practical exercises, guides, prompts, and reference resources
  • Help define curriculum structure, learning objectives, and competency frameworks
  • Review content for technical accuracy and industry relevance
  • Share insights on AI tools, workflows, and emerging trends
  • Collaborate with instructional designers and curriculum teams to continuously improve learning outcomes
  • Support program updates based on learner feedback and market needs

Areas of involvement

  • Instructor — leads live sessions, workshops, and learner interactions.
  • Author — creates course content, lessons, assessments, and projects.
  • Subject Matter Expert — shapes curriculum strategy, competency frameworks, and program direction.

⌛ All roles are part-time: 10–15 hours per week.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing automation workflows in business operations environments
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, n8n, Power Automate, UiPath, or similar tools
  • Experience with AI-powered automation, API integrations, prompt engineering, RPA platforms, and real-world operational workflows
  • Strong ability to share knowledge through content creation, training, mentoring, or facilitation, making complex automation concepts clear, practical, and engaging for learners
  • Ability to work independently with strong ownership and minimal supervision
  • Availability to collaborate within European time zones
  • Ability to dedicate approximately 10–15 hours per week
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); Russian or Spanish is a strong plus
  • Background in automation consulting, business process improvement, operations leadership, advocacy, mentoring, conference speaking, or technical community engagement is a plus

Nice-to-have

  • Deep expertise in business process automation, workflow design, or digital operations transformation
  • Ability to evaluate real-world automation implementations, tool ecosystems, and AI-augmented workflows
  • Experience creating competency maps, skill frameworks, learning roadmaps, or curriculum structures
  • Ability to review technical learning content and provide structured feedback

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• The opportunity to teach while maintaining your primary job: Share your expertise without leaving your current role.
  • Competitive hourly rate of $40-$85 USD for flexible part-time collaboration with significant impact and an amazing team!
  • Remote cooperation with a schedule convenient for both you and the team: We don't focus on micromanagement.
  • Cross-cultural experience: Become part of an international team and connect with professional developers from diverse backgrounds.
  • Meaningful impact: Share your knowledge and help experienced engineers advance their skills in AI-assisted development.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy is an educational platform helping business professionals and operations teams stay ahead of the automation curve. We build specialized courses that teach practitioners how to design, implement, and scale AI-powered workflows using modern automation tools — from no-code platforms to enterprise-grade integrations.

Our programs are built for people who work in the real world: operations managers, business analysts, automation engineers, and digital transformation leads. We help them move beyond manual processes and become confident architects of intelligent workflows.

Our mission is to give professionals the knowledge and hands-on skills to automate smarter — and lead their organizations through the shift.

Who are we looking for?

We are building a talent pool of automation practitioners and business technology experts for ongoing roles as Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts in our AI Automation program.

We are looking for specialists across a range of seniority levels and focus areas:

  • Junior (Instructor / Technical Trainer) — 1–3 years designing or supporting automation workflows. Hands-on experience with tools like Zapier, Make, or n8n. Comfortable walking learners through workflows step-by-step with practical, repeatable examples.
  • Mid (Author / Automation Engineer) — 3–6 years implementing automation across business operations. Experience with API integrations, prompt engineering, and RPA platforms. Able to explain automation concepts clearly and debug issues in real time.
  • Senior (Subject Matter Expert / Automation Architect) — 6+ years in automation solution architecture, complex integrations, and large-scale project delivery. Experienced working with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Strong background in business analysis and digital transformation.

A strong candidate doesn't just know automation tools — they use them daily and can teach others to do the same. We look for practitioners who have replaced real manual processes with working solutions, not just people who have studied the theory.

These are Talent Pool positions — we continuously review applications and build our roster of experts. There may not be an immediate opening at the time you apply, but strong candidates will be added to our talent pool and contacted as relevant opportunities arise.

You can join us on a part-time basis (10–15 hours per week) as an instructor leading live sessions and workshops, as a course author creating learning materials, or as a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development.

Apply now — we review applications on an ongoing basis. Our selection process is fully asynchronous and designed to respect your time:

  1. Application Review — we evaluate your profile against our current needs
  2. Async Video Interview — a short self-recorded interview (10–15 minutes max)
  3. Test Assignment — approximately 1 hour to complete
  4. Talent Pool — finalists are added to our active roster of vetted experts
  5. Hiring Manager & Tech Expert Call — once a relevant position opens, we invite you to a live interview with our team
  6. Offer — we extend an offer for a relevant position upon successful completion of the process


Please submit your resume in English.

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is a service that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.


🚀 Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.


What is our goal? We are continuously looking for experienced AI Automation professionals who want to support and guide our students on their path to becoming professional developers. This is a full-time teaching role with an expectation of 40 hours per week. The schedule can be flexible, but you must be consistently available to support students throughout their learning journey.

How to apply? Apply here. We review applications on a rolling basis, and candidates whose profiles align with the role will be invited to complete a digital interview, and complete a short technical test task.


If a vacancy is available, we will assign it to you right away; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed task on file for future opportunities.


📌 Please submit your CV in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Mentor students through 1:1 video calls, addressing a wide range of questions, clarifying complex concepts, and helping students navigate their assignments.

  • Review and assess student projects in alignment with program standards and best practices, providing clear, constructive feedback.
  • Engage with students on the TripleTen Hub, offering written guidance and supporting ongoing communication.
  • Share your professional expertise and best industry practices to equip students with relevant insights and strategies for their careers.
  • Create and curate educational resources within the TripleTen Hub to enhance student learning and make knowledge more accessible.
  • Foster a collaborative learning community by encouraging student interaction, building a sense of belonging, and cultivating a network of shared knowledge and mutual support.
  • Host Mock Technical Interviews providing constructive feedback on both their technical responses and interview skills.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:

name: AI for Business & Transformation Teaching Experts

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy is an educational platform that helps business professionals and organizations navigate the era of AI-driven transformation. We create specialized courses that teach practitioners how to apply AI tools strategically in real-world business workflows — across sales, marketing, learning & development, and organizational management.

Our programs are designed for working professionals who need to act on AI, not just understand it. We focus on practical adoption, measurable impact, and the kind of judgment that comes from experience — helping individuals and teams lead change, not react to it.

Our mission is to equip business professionals with the knowledge and frameworks to make smart AI decisions, drive adoption across their organizations, and become leaders in the new era of work.

Who are we looking for?

We are building a talent pool of experienced business professionals, consultants, and transformation leaders for ongoing roles as Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts across our AI for Business & Transformation program.

Our courses cover: AI for Smart Work, AI for Sales, AI for L&D, AI for Marketing, and AI for Teachers.

We recruit across three experience levels:

Junior Specialists (Instructors / Technical Trainers / Automation Specialists) bring 1–3 years of hands-on experience with AI tools or digital transformation initiatives. They explain AI concepts clearly, without technical jargon, and are comfortable teaching non-technical audiences.

Middle Experts (Authors / Automation Consultants / Automation Engineers) have 3–6 years of experience implementing AI in real organizations. They work with business examples and case studies, and can explain the reasoning behind technology choices — including build vs. buy decisions and AI governance basics.

Senior SMEs (AI Consultants / Automation Architects / Technology Strategists) bring 6+ years of experience working with business leaders and C-level stakeholders. They speak to ROI, digital transformation strategy, AI governance, and organizational change management.

What sets our experts apart is the ability to translate real-world AI experience into learning that sticks — for audiences who are already senior, already busy, and already skeptical of hype.

These are Talent Pool positions — we continuously review applications and build our roster of experts. There may not be an immediate opening at the time you apply, but strong candidates will be added to our talent pool and contacted as relevant opportunities arise.

You can join us on a part-time basis (10–15 hours per week) as an instructor leading live sessions, a course author creating learning materials, or a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development.

Apply now — we review applications on an ongoing basis. Our selection process is fully asynchronous and designed to respect your time:

  1. Application Review — we evaluate your profile against our current needs
  2. Async Video Interview — a short self-recorded interview (10–15 minutes max)
  3. Test Assignment — approximately 1 hour to complete
  4. Talent Pool — finalists are added to our active roster of vetted experts
  5. Hiring Manager Call — once a relevant position opens, we invite you to a live interview with our team
  6. Offer — we extend an offer for a relevant position upon successful completion of the process

Please submit your resume in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
Available Roles

We are building a talent pool of Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts for our AI for Business & Transformation programs. We hire on an ongoing basis across the following specializations:

Most in demand: AI for Smart Work, AI for Sales, AI for Marketing, AI for L&D, AI for Teachers

Also relevant: other business functions and organizational transformation domains

Depending on your expertise, you may:

  • Deliver live workshops and training sessions
  • Create educational content, assessments, and project-based learning materials
  • Design practical exercises, guides, prompts, and reference resources
  • Help define curriculum structure, learning objectives, and competency frameworks
  • Review content for technical accuracy and industry relevance
  • Share insights on AI tools, workflows, and emerging trends
  • Collaborate with instructional designers and curriculum teams to continuously improve learning outcomes
  • Support program updates based on learner feedback and market needs

Areas of involvement

  • Instructor — leads live sessions, workshops, and learner interactions.
  • Author — creates course content, lessons, assessments, and projects.
  • Subject Matter Expert — shapes curriculum strategy, competency frameworks, and program direction.

⌛ All roles are part-time: 10–15 hours per week.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 1+ years of experience implementing AI tools or contributing to digital transformation initiatives in business environments
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools relevant to business workflows, such as ChatGPT, Copilot for M365, Make, Zapier, Notion AI, or similar
  • Practical understanding of AI use cases across business functions such as sales, marketing, L&D, operations, or related areas
  • Ability to explain AI concepts clearly, using practical business examples and actionable use cases for non-technical audiences
  • Strong ability to share knowledge through consulting, training, content creation, coaching, mentoring, or facilitation
  • Ability to work independently with strong ownership and minimal supervision
  • Availability to collaborate within European time zones
  • Ability to dedicate approximately 10–15 hours per week
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); Russian or Spanish is a strong plus
  • Background in business consulting, corporate training, professional coaching, digital transformation, or knowledge-sharing is a plus

Nice-to-have

  • 6+ years of experience working with business leaders, senior managers, or C-level stakeholders on AI adoption, digital transformation, or organizational change initiatives
  • Ability to evaluate real-world AI applications in business contexts and distinguish practical, high-ROI approaches from hype
  • Experience creating competency maps, maturity frameworks, skill decompositions, or curriculum structures
  • Familiarity with AI governance, build-vs-buy decisions, and change management principles
  • Ability to review learning content and provide structured feedback

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• The opportunity to teach while maintaining your primary job: Share your expertise without leaving your current role.
  • Competitive hourly rate of $40-$150 USD for flexible part-time collaboration with significant impact and an amazing team!
  • Remote cooperation with a schedule convenient for both you and the team: We don't focus on micromanagement.
  • Cross-cultural experience: Become part of an international team and connect with professional developers from diverse backgrounds.
  • Meaningful impact: Share your knowledge and help experienced engineers advance their skills in AI-assisted development.
  • Participation in innovative projects: Contribute to shaping the future of programming education and AI adoption.
  • Professional growth: Receive feedback and develop your skills as a technical educator and thought leader.

name: AI for Content Creation Teaching Expert

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy is an international online learning platform that helps individuals and teams master AI and cloud technologies. We deliver hands-on, industry-relevant learning experiences that combine expert knowledge with practical application.

We are looking for an experienced visual-content practitioner with hands-on AI expertise to join us as an AI for Content Creation Teaching Expert. This role combines live instruction with subject-matter expertise: you will deliver practical sessions and collaborate with the course team to refine the methodology, cases, templates, and exercises.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Deliver engaging live sessions, workshops, and applied learning labs.
  • Demonstrate real-world AI workflows for visual, video, document, and interactive content production.
  • Help learners set up brand assets and create on-brand presentations, one-pagers, and documents using Claude Design or similar tools.
  • Guide participants in generating and editing visual assets, including banners, key visuals, and illustrations.
  • Demonstrate how to create short videos, animations, and explainer content using AI.
  • Support hands-on projects involving interactive pages and widgets built through vibe-coding.
  • Show learners how to automate recurring production work using plugins and simple pipelines.
  • Provide structured feedback and help participants adapt the workflows to their own professional environments.
  • Collaborate with the course team to refine materials, templates, checklists, and case studies.
  • Continuously improve the course based on learner feedback, industry developments, and changes in the AI tool landscape.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must Have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in visual and/or video content creation, communications design, marketing production, or a related field.
  • Practical understanding of the full content production lifecycle, from a brief and brand toolkit to a finished, format-ready deliverable.
  • Proven hands-on experience applying generative AI in real content-production workflows.
  • Experience with AI image-generation and editing tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with AI video and animation tools such as RunwayML, Higgsfield, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with AI-powered layout and document tools such as Claude Design or comparable solutions.
  • Experience building interactive content through vibe-coding tools such as Claude, Lovable, or similar platforms.
  • Experience automating recurring production tasks through plugins or simple workflows using tools such as n8n, Google Sheets, or Google Calendar.
  • Experience applying AI in a real business environment, such as a startup, scale-up, or enterprise.
  • Strong communication and teaching skills, with the ability to explain practical workflows to non-technical audiences.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Availability to work within European time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering workshops, live training, webinars, or internal enablement sessions.
  • Experience producing content for internal communications, marketing, events, or partnership teams.
  • Experience translating brand guidelines into repeatable AI-assisted production systems.
  • Experience designing templates, checklists, learning materials, or practical case studies.
  • Experience assessing AI-generated content for quality, brand consistency, usability, and production readiness.
  • Additional language skills relevant to international audiences.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• The opportunity to shape a practical AI course built around real content-production workflows.
  • A role that combines hands-on teaching with subject-matter expertise and course development.
  • Collaboration with an international curriculum and learning team.
  • The opportunity to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, reusable methods for professional teams.
  • Direct influence on course materials, templates, cases, and applied exercises.
  • Work with learners who want to implement AI in their real professional environments.

Compensation, contract terms, expected workload, and project duration will be discussed separately.

This role combines live instruction with subject-matter expertise: you will deliver practical sessions and collaborate with the course team to refine the methodology, cases, templates, and exercises.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Deliver engaging live sessions, workshops, and applied learning labs.
  • Demonstrate real-world AI workflows for visual, video, document, and interactive content production.
  • Help learners set up brand assets and create on-brand presentations, one-pagers, and documents using Claude Design or similar tools.
  • Guide participants in generating and editing visual assets, including banners, key visuals, and illustrations.
  • Demonstrate how to create short videos, animations, and explainer content using AI.
  • Support hands-on projects involving interactive pages and widgets built through vibe-coding.
  • Show learners how to automate recurring production work using plugins and simple pipelines.
  • Provide structured feedback and help participants adapt the workflows to their own professional environments.
  • Collaborate with the course team to refine materials, templates, checklists, and case studies.
  • Continuously improve the course based on learner feedback, industry developments, and changes in the AI tool landscape.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must Have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in visual and/or video content creation, communications design, marketing production, or a related field.
  • Practical understanding of the full content production lifecycle, from a brief and brand toolkit to a finished, format-ready deliverable.
  • Proven hands-on experience applying generative AI in real content-production workflows.
  • Experience with AI image-generation and editing tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with AI video and animation tools such as RunwayML, Higgsfield, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with AI-powered layout and document tools such as Claude Design or comparable solutions.
  • Experience building interactive content through vibe-coding tools such as Claude, Lovable, or similar platforms.
  • Experience automating recurring production tasks through plugins or simple workflows using tools such as n8n, Google Sheets, or Google Calendar.
  • Experience applying AI in a real business environment, such as a startup, scale-up, or enterprise.
  • Strong communication and teaching skills, with the ability to explain practical workflows to non-technical audiences.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Availability to work within European time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering workshops, live training, webinars, or internal enablement sessions.
  • Experience producing content for internal communications, marketing, events, or partnership teams.
  • Experience translating brand guidelines into repeatable AI-assisted production systems.
  • Experience designing templates, checklists, learning materials, or practical case studies.
  • Experience assessing AI-generated content for quality, brand consistency, usability, and production readiness.
  • Additional language skills relevant to international audiences.

  • A role that combines hands-on teaching with subject-matter expertise and course development.

  • The opportunity to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, reusable methods for professional teams.
  • Direct influence on course materials, templates, cases, and applied exercises.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy is an educational platform that helps business professionals and organizations navigate the era of AI-driven transformation. We create specialized courses that teach practitioners how to apply AI tools strategically in real-world business workflows.

Our programs are designed for working professionals who need to act on AI, not just understand it. We focus on practical adoption, measurable impact, and the kind of judgment that comes from experience — helping individuals and teams lead change, not react to it.

Our mission is to equip business professionals with the knowledge and frameworks to make smart AI decisions, drive adoption across their organizations, and become leaders in the new era of work.

Who are we looking for?

We are building a talent pool of experienced business professionals, consultants, and transformation leaders for ongoing roles as Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts for our AI for Managers course.

AI for Managers is a practical program designed for business leaders who need to make real decisions about AI — how to adopt it, how to lead their teams through it, and how to measure its impact. The course covers AI strategy, change management, governance, and hands-on application across business functions.

We recruit across three role types:

Instructors deliver the AI for Managers curriculum live — facilitating sessions, handling Q&A, and adapting content to their audience. They have proven experience training managers and business leaders, strong facilitation skills, and the ability to explain AI in simple, decision-oriented language without technical jargon.

Authors design and write the learning materials for AI for Managers — building frameworks, case studies, and structured content tailored to non-technical, managerial audiences. They bring 7+ years in consulting, digital transformation, or IT/business leadership, and have hands-on experience leading AI implementation initiatives.

Subject Matter Experts combine deep domain expertise with the ability to both create curriculum and deliver it live. They bring 7+ years working with C-level stakeholders on AI and digital transformation, have led end-to-end AI adoption across cross-functional organizations, and can serve as authoritative voices for senior, skeptical audiences.

What sets our experts apart is the ability to translate real-world AI implementation experience into learning that sticks — for audiences who are already senior, already busy, and already skeptical of hype.

These are Talent Pool positions — we continuously review applications and build our roster of experts. There may not be an immediate opening at the time you apply, but strong candidates will be added to our talent pool and contacted as relevant opportunities arise.

You can join us on a part-time basis (10–15 hours per week) as an instructor leading live sessions, a course author creating learning materials, or a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development.

Apply now — we review applications on an ongoing basis. Our selection process is fully asynchronous and designed to respect your time:

  1. Application Review — we evaluate your profile against our current needs
  2. Async Video Interview — a short self-recorded interview (10–15 minutes max)
  3. Test Assignment — approximately 1 hour to complete
  4. Talent Pool — finalists are added to our active roster of vetted experts
  5. Hiring Manager Call — once a relevant position opens, we invite you to a live interview with our team
  6. Offer — we extend an offer for a relevant position upon successful completion of the process


Please submit your resume in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
Available Roles

We are building a talent pool of Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts for our AI for Managers course. We hire on an ongoing basis.

Depending on your expertise, you may:

  • Deliver live workshops and training sessions
  • Create educational content, assessments, and project-based learning materials
  • Design practical exercises, guides, prompts, and reference resources
  • Help define curriculum structure, learning objectives, and competency frameworks
  • Review content for technical accuracy and industry relevance
  • Share insights on AI tools, workflows, and emerging trends
  • Collaborate with instructional designers and curriculum teams to continuously improve learning outcomes
  • Support program updates based on learner feedback and market needs

Areas of involvement

  • Instructor — leads live sessions, workshops, and learner interactions.
  • Author — creates course content, lessons, assessments, and projects.
  • Subject Matter Expert — shapes curriculum strategy, competency frameworks, and program direction.

⌛ All roles are part-time: 10–15 hours per week.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 7+ years of experience in consulting, digital transformation, AI adoption, or business/IT leadership
  • Hands-on experience leading AI implementation initiatives, including vendor selection, pilots, rollouts, and organizational adoption
  • Strong understanding of AI adoption challenges, governance, change management, and cross-functional alignment
  • Ability to explain complex AI concepts clearly to non-technical, managerial audiences using practical, decision-oriented frameworks
  • Strong ability to share knowledge through consulting, training, content creation, workshops, or facilitation
  • Experience delivering training, workshops, or professional learning programs, with the ability to facilitate discussions, adapt content to different audience maturity levels, and effectively work within an established curriculum
  • Ability to work independently with strong ownership and minimal supervision
  • Availability to collaborate within European time zones
  • Ability to dedicate approximately 10–15 hours per week
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); Spanish is a strong plus

Nice-to-have

  • Experience creating competency maps, maturity frameworks, skill decompositions, or curriculum structures
  • Ability to evaluate real-world AI applications in business contexts and distinguish practical, high-ROI approaches from hype
  • Ability to review learning content and provide structured feedback
  • Familiarity with change management frameworks such as ADKAR, Prosci, or equivalent

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• The opportunity to teach while maintaining your primary job: Share your expertise without leaving your current role.
  • Competitive hourly rate of $40-$150 USD for flexible part-time collaboration with significant impact and an amazing team!
  • Remote cooperation with a schedule convenient for both you and the team: We don't focus on micromanagement.
  • Cross-cultural experience: Become part of an international team and connect with professional developers from diverse backgrounds.
  • Meaningful impact: Share your knowledge and help experienced engineers advance their skills in AI-assisted development.
  • Participation in innovative projects: Contribute to shaping the future of programming education and AI adoption.
  • Professional growth: Receive feedback and develop your skills as a technical educator and thought leader.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy (powered by Tripleten) is an international educational platform that helps business professionals and organizations navigate AI-driven transformation. We create practical programs that help teams apply AI tools to real business workflows, make informed decisions, and lead organizational change.

We are looking for a senior AI for Operations Teaching Expert with direct professional experience in the insurance or insurance-brokerage industry and strong knowledge of the Latin American business environment.

You will deliver a live virtual program for operations teams and mid-level managers at a major LATAM insurance-brokerage group. The program will focus on practical AI applications for operational workflows, process automation, productivity, quality control, data-driven decision-making, and business transformation.

The workshop materials are already prepared. Your role will be to deliver the sessions, prepare through dry runs, adapt examples to the insurance-brokerage and operations context, and help participants apply the course concepts to their own operational workflows and business projects.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Deliver live virtual sessions for operations teams and mid-level managers in LATAM.
  • Prepare for sessions through dry runs and alignment with the Customer Success and Program teams.
  • Adapt already-prepared workshop materials, examples, and discussions to the insurance / insurance-brokerage context.
  • Explain practical AI applications for operations, including process automation, workflow optimization, productivity, quality control, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Help participants identify where AI can reduce manual work, improve process visibility, and support better operational decisions.
  • Provide real-world case studies and examples relevant to operations teams in insurance or insurance brokerage.
  • Support participants in applying the course concepts to their own operational workflows and business projects.
  • Act as a subject-matter expert on the operational, governance, and risk implications of AI adoption.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must Have

  • Direct professional experience in the insurance or insurance-brokerage industry.
  • Prior professional experience working in LATAM, ideally in Chile or with Chilean / LATAM corporate clients.
  • Strong understanding of operational workflows, back-office processes, or process improvement in a business context.
  • Strong command of AI concepts and practical AI tools applicable to operational workflows.
  • Experience teaching, training, mentoring, consulting, or advising business professionals.
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish.
  • Professional English.
  • Comfortable delivering virtual, live instruction to corporate groups.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with corporate / B2B training programs.
  • Background in process improvement, operational excellence, Lean, Six Sigma, digital transformation, or change management.
  • Experience working with back-office, claims, underwriting, finance, administration, HR, business intelligence, systems, collections, or other non-commercial operations teams.
  • Familiarity with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or other AI platforms in an operational or business-process setting.
  • Portuguese language skills.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• A part-time contract expert role with Nebius Academy.
  • Remote live virtual delivery for corporate cohorts in LATAM.
  • Opportunity to work on a practical AI transformation program for a major insurance-brokerage client.
  • Prepared workshop materials and support from the Program and Customer Success teams.
  • Flexible collaboration format aligned with cohort scheduling.
  • Compensation $50 - 150 USD per hour, depending on experience and fit

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy is an international online learning platform helping engineering teams master AI and cloud technologies. We build hands-on, industry-relevant programs for B2B audiences — combining deep technical expertise with real-world application.

Our QA curriculum focuses on AI-assisted quality engineering: how to use modern AI tools to write smarter tests, automate faster, and build more reliable mobile and backend products.

Who are we looking for?

We are building a talent pool of experienced QA engineers and technical experts for ongoing roles as Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts in our AI-assisted QA educational program.

We are looking for specialists across the following areas: Kotlin, Swift, Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Mobile QA (Android / iOS), and other languages with a QA focus.

A strong candidate doesn't just know their stack deeply — they actively use AI-assisted QA tools in their daily workflow. We prioritize hands-on experience with tools such as Cursor, testRigor, Magic Inspector, Rainforest QA, AI-powered test generation, agentic workflows, MCP ecosystem integrations, or similar. The ability to teach others how to integrate these tools into real QA practice is what sets our experts apart.

These are Talent Pool positions — we continuously review applications and build our roster of experts. This means there may not be an immediate opening at the time you apply, but strong candidates will be added to our talent pool and contacted as relevant opportunities arise.

You can join us on a part-time basis (~10–15h/week), contributing as an instructor leading live sessions and workshops, as a course author creating learning materials, or as a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development. Teaching sessions are compensated separately.

Compensation: $40–80/hour, depending on experience and format of collaboration.

Our selection process is fully asynchronous and designed to respect your time:

  1. Application Review — we evaluate your profile against our current needs
  2. Async Video Interview — a short self-recorded interview (10–15 minutes max)
  3. Test Assignment — approximately 1 hour to complete
  4. Talent Pool — finalists are added to our active roster of vetted experts
  5. Hiring Manager & Tech Expert Call — once a relevant position opens, we invite you to a live interview with our team
  6. Offer — we extend an offer for a relevant position upon successful completion of the process

Apply now — we review applications on an ongoing basis.

Please submit your resume in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
Available Roles

We are building a talent pool of Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts for our AI-assisted QA educational programs. We hire on an ongoing basis across the following specializations:

Most in demand: AI for Manual QA, AI for Automated Testing, AI for Mobile QA (Kotlin / Android / iOS) Also relevant: other languages and QA domains

Depending on your expertise, you may:

  • Deliver live workshops and training sessions
  • Create educational content, assessments, and project-based learning materials
  • Design practical exercises, guides, prompts, and reference resources
  • Help define curriculum structure, learning objectives, and competency frameworks
  • Review content for technical accuracy and industry relevance
  • Share insights on AI tools, workflows, and emerging trends
  • Collaborate with instructional designers and curriculum teams to continuously improve learning outcomes
  • Support program updates based on learner feedback and market needs

Areas of involvement

  • Instructor — leads live sessions, workshops, and learner interactions.
  • Author — creates course content, lessons, assessments, and projects.
  • Subject Matter Expert — shapes curriculum strategy, competency frameworks, and program direction.

⌛ All roles are part-time: 10–15 hours per week.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 5+ years of experience in QA Engineering, with a strong focus on mobile QA (Android/iOS), test automation, or AI-assisted quality engineering
  • Solid knowledge of one or more of the following: Kotlin, Swift, Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted QA tools such as Cursor, testRigor, Magic Inspector, Rainforest QA, MCP ecosystem integrations, agentic workflows, or similar, with real implementation experience and measurable impact
  • Strong ability to share knowledge through content creation, training, mentoring, or facilitation, making complex QA concepts clear, practical, and engaging for learners
  • Ability to work independently with strong ownership and minimal supervision
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Availability to collaborate within European time zones
  • Ability to dedicate approximately 10–15 hours per week
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); Russian or Spanish is a strong plus
  • Background in QA advocacy, tech leadership, mentoring, conference speaking, or technical community engagement is a plus

Nice-to-have

  • Strong expertise in QA Engineering, Test Automation, or AI-assisted Quality Engineering
  • Ability to evaluate real-world AI/QA tools, testing architectures, and workflows, distinguishing practical approaches from hype
  • Experience creating competency maps, skill frameworks, learning roadmaps, or curriculum structures
  • Ability to review technical learning content and provide structured feedback

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• The opportunity to create impactful content while maintaining your primary job: Share your expertise without leaving your current role
  • Competitive hourly rate of $40-$85 USD for flexible part-time collaboration with significant impact and an amazing team!
  • Remote cooperation with a schedule convenient for both you and the team: We don't focus on micromanagement
  • Cross-cultural experience: Become part of an international team and connect with professionals from diverse backgrounds
  • Meaningful impact: Share your knowledge and help experienced engineers advance their skills through high-quality educational content
  • Participation in innovative projects: Contribute to shaping the future of programming education and AI adoption
  • Professional growth: Receive feedback and develop your skills as a technical content creator and thought leader

We are looking for an AI Labs Teaching Expert to facilitate the Business Track for professionals working in operations, product management, marketing, business analysis, consulting and team leadership. You will help participants identify the right automation opportunity, define a realistic scope and build a practical solution during the session.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Review participant project cards before each session and help participants prepare the necessary data and materials.
  • Assess each project and clearly define what should be included, reduced or removed from the Lab scope.
  • Help participants map recurring business tasks and identify the most valuable automation opportunities.
  • Guide participants in designing and building practical AI-assisted workflows.
  • Help participants choose the appropriate level of automation, from reusable prompts and custom assistants to agents and workflow automation tools.
  • Advise participants on ROI, process impact, approval steps, routing, error handling and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Work across the AI assistants and automation tools available in participants’ organisations.
  • Diagnose where a participant is actually blocked and break the project into achievable next steps.
  • Run an engaging online session, balance individual support with group progress and provide specific, immediately actionable feedback.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must Have

  • Hands-on experience automating recurring work across more than one business function.
  • Proven experience implementing AI or automation solutions in live business processes—not only personal experiments, demonstrations, or strategy work.
  • Ability to evaluate automation opportunities based on frequency, volume, process variance, expected ROI, and business impact.
  • Sound judgment about which tasks or decisions should not be automated and where human review or approval must remain.
  • Experience building multi-step automations that include branching, routing, approvals, error handling, or similar operational logic.
  • Experience creating reusable AI assistants, custom GPTs, project instructions, decision agents, or comparable solutions used by other people.
  • Production-level experience with at least one automation platform such as Zapier, Make, or n8n.
  • Working familiarity with several major AI assistants, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.
  • Experience facilitating workshops, teaching, mentoring, consulting, or sharing practical knowledge with non-technical professionals.
  • Ability to diagnose participant blockers, reduce an oversized project to a realistic three-hour scope, and coach participants without taking over their work.
  • Professional working proficiency in Russian sufficient to conduct live interactive Labs, explain complex concepts, and provide actionable feedback.
  • Strong English communication skills for working with the Nebius Academy team and course materials.
  • Availability to deliver live online sessions according to the agreed CET schedule.

Nice to Have

  • Experience as an AI Enablement Lead, AI Adoption or Transformation Manager, GenAI Program Manager, Automation Consultant, operations leader, or Forward-Deployed Engineer.
  • Experience supporting AI adoption across several departments, business functions, or client organizations.
  • Experience in operationally intensive sectors such as e-commerce, marketplaces, fintech, food-tech, mobility, or similar environments.
  • Experience connecting automation initiatives to measurable operational or business outcomes.
  • A STEM education or another relevant technical background.
  • Public case studies, talks, publications, or other examples of practical AI or automation projects.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• A project-based, part-time collaboration with Nebius Academy.
  • The opportunity to help professionals build useful AI systems around their own business processes.
  • A practical delivery format focused on measurable outcomes and working solutions.
  • A fully remote collaboration with sessions aligned with CET.
  • A clear delivery scope for each Lab, including preparation and coordination with the Nebius Academy team.
  • The opportunity to work with participants from different functions, industries and levels of AI maturity.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) runs AI Labs: three-hour live online sessions where engineers bring a real repository, pipeline or test suite and leave with a working AI deliverable configured against their own code and standards.

We are looking for an AI Labs Teaching Expert to facilitate the Tech Track across our QA and AI-assisted programming courses. You will guide participants through real technical projects, help them make sound architecture and scoping decisions, and support them in producing a working result during the session.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Review participant project cards before each session and prepare the relevant materials.
  • Assess the scope of each project and help participants define what can realistically be completed during the Lab.
  • Work alongside participants as they design, configure and test their AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Read unfamiliar repositories quickly enough to identify issues and provide actionable guidance.
  • Help participants debug agent state, routing and behaviour under time pressure.
  • Guide participants in configuring AI code review, repository-level instructions and agent governance.
  • Help participants define appropriate automation boundaries, retry limits and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Run an engaging online session, move effectively between participant projects and keep the whole group progressing.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must Have

  • Production experience integrating AI tooling into a real team’s repository, engineering workflow or CI pipeline.
  • Experience running an LLM API in a production CI environment, including cost, latency, retry and failure-mode considerations.
  • Hands-on experience with AI code review, repository-level configuration, agent instructions or AI governance files used by a team.
  • Strong software engineering background and the ability to understand backend, frontend, ETL, testing and model-related components.
  • Experience defining automation boundaries, human-in-the-loop gates and safe retry behaviour.
  • Ability to diagnose whether an agent failure comes from the prompt, routing or state design.
  • Experience stress-testing AI systems using intentionally incorrect inputs, pull requests or edge cases.
  • Daily practical use of a coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex.
  • Hands-on experience with CI platforms; strong familiarity with GitHub Actions or a comparable platform.
  • Practical experience with Playwright.
  • Production experience with LangGraph and LangSmith.
  • Experience building or operating multi-agent systems with tracing and evaluation.
  • Strong live facilitation, coaching or technical knowledge-sharing skills.
  • Ability to facilitate the current Labs in Russian.
  • Availability to support the mid-October launch and the planned October–November delivery schedule.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading an organisation-wide rollout of AI coding tools.
  • Experience as a Staff or Senior Software Engineer, AI Platform Engineer, QA Automation Architect, SDET Lead, Applied AI Engineer or Forward-Deployed Engineer.
  • Experience with automated or self-healing test suites.
  • Experience teaching or facilitating engineers in a live online environment.
  • Experience working with unfamiliar repositories and technology stacks.
  • Experience with QA-oriented AI use cases.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• A project-based, part-time collaboration with Nebius Academy.
  • The opportunity to work with experienced professionals on real AI-assisted engineering projects.
  • A practical delivery format focused on working results rather than theoretical demonstrations.
  • A fully remote collaboration with sessions aligned with CET.
  • A clear delivery scope for each Lab, including preparation and coordination with the Nebius Academy team.
  • An opportunity to influence how engineering teams use AI tools safely and effectively in their daily work.

details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓At TripleTen, we're building an international platform of digital re-skilling products to help people from diverse backgrounds learn new professions and build sustainable careers in tech.


Our program graduates have landed jobs at top companies like Tesla, Spotify, PlayStation, Google, and Microsoft. So far, over 5,000 students have chosen TripleTen, and hundreds of new students are joining us each month. We believe everyone can jumpstart a new career, which is why we produce quality educational content and offer intensive courses in tech complete with full access to an interactive platform, code reviews, and support from industry practitioners.


Now, we are looking for an experienced AI Product Management Subject Matter Expert (SME) to author the core instructional content for a new AI Product Management program designed for career changers with no prior tech background.


The SME will be responsible for content creation across ~7 2-week modules, aligned to an existing syllabus, including explanations, examples, frameworks, assignments, and case-study guidance.


Please submit all resumes or CV's in English.

﻿

Please note that after applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call.🚀

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Author clear, structured, beginner-friendly curriculum content (e.g. written text, visual elements, tasks, assessment questions, and real-world projects).
  • Translate real-world AI PM experience into teachable concepts and applied examples.
  • Write supporting material such as rubrics and project review guidelines for project reviewers and troubleshooting guides for support.
  • Collaborate closely with our Learning Experience (LX) Designer to ensure consistency across the program.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Professional experience in AI Product Management, Product Management or similar roles, 5+ years:

-End-to-end product management (strategy, discovery, delivery, Agile).

-User research, analytics, prioritization, and roadmap ownership.

-AI/GenAI product development (LLMs, prompts, RAG, AI tradeoffs).

-Shipping and scaling AI-powered features with ML teams.

-AI UX, evaluation metrics, and quality assurance.

-Responsible AI (ethics, bias, privacy, compliance awareness).

-Strong communicator for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with vibe-coding tools and workflows for task automation.
  • Up-to-date industry knowledge and ability to describe difficult concepts in a comprehensible way.
  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken).
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Learning Experience Designer and product managers.
  • Experience in mentoring/supervising.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in Product Management workflows and the ability to integrate them meaningfully into projects and lessons.
  • Time commitment: able to devote 20-30 hours per week for collaboration.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience teaching or creating educational content.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or instructional design.
  • Clear opinions on how beginners should best learn AI Product Management.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Fully remote work with flexible hours.
  • Hands-on experience in a growing EdTech environment.
  • A digital office — we use modern tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Figma) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy — no micromanaging.
  • The chance to see real impact: our metric is graduates landing jobs in tech.
  • Join a diverse, international, and close-knit team excited to work with you.

So far, over 5,000 students have chosen TripleTen, and hundreds of new students are joining us each month. We believe everyone can jumpstart a new career, which is why we produce quality educational content and offer intensive courses in tech complete with full access to an interactive platform, code reviews, and support from industry practitioners.


Now, we are looking for an experienced AI Product Management Subject Matter Expert (SME) to author the core instructional content for a new AI Product Management program designed for career changers with no prior tech background.


The SME will be responsible for content creation across ~7 2-week modules, aligned to an existing syllabus, including explanations, examples, frameworks, assignments, and case-study guidance.


Please submit all resumes or CV's in English.

﻿

Please note that after applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call.🚀

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Author clear, structured, beginner-friendly curriculum content (e.g. written text, visual elements, tasks, assessment questions, and real-world projects).
  • Translate real-world AI PM experience into teachable concepts and applied examples.
  • Write supporting material such as rubrics and project review guidelines for project reviewers and troubleshooting guides for support.
  • Collaborate closely with our Learning Experience (LX) Designer to ensure consistency across the program.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Professional experience in AI Product Management, Product Management or similar roles, 5+ years:

-End-to-end product management (strategy, discovery, delivery, Agile).

-User research, analytics, prioritization, and roadmap ownership.

-AI/GenAI product development (LLMs, prompts, RAG, AI tradeoffs).

-Shipping and scaling AI-powered features with ML teams.

-AI UX, evaluation metrics, and quality assurance.

-Responsible AI (ethics, bias, privacy, compliance awareness).

-Strong communicator for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with vibe-coding tools and workflows for task automation.
  • Up-to-date industry knowledge and ability to describe difficult concepts in a comprehensible way.
  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken).
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Learning Experience Designer and product managers.
  • Experience in mentoring/supervising.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in Product Management workflows and the ability to integrate them meaningfully into projects and lessons.
  • Time commitment: able to devote 20-30 hours per week for collaboration.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience teaching or creating educational content.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or instructional design.
  • Clear opinions on how beginners should best learn AI Product Management.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Fully remote work with flexible hours.
  • Hands-on experience in a growing EdTech environment.
  • A digital office — we use modern tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Figma) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy — no micromanaging.
  • The chance to see real impact: our metric is graduates landing jobs in tech.
  • Join a diverse, international, and close-knit team excited to work with you.

We're launching a program for experienced engineers transitioning into system architecture roles. The curriculum is being built by a team of senior authors. The best person for this is someone who has actually designed and shipped systems at scale, has opinions about what good architecture looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their design is wrong, not just whether it runs.

  • Module 1 — Foundations of System Engineering (Architecture principles, OpenTelemetry, distributed systems)

  • Module 3 — Data Architecture & Storage Patterns (SQL/NoSQL, sharding, replication, Redis caching)

Expert B — Cloud, Distributed Systems

  • Module 4 — Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering (Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, FinOps)
  • Module 5 — Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture (CAP theorem, event-driven, Kafka, alert routing)

Expert C — Security, AI Systems & Architecture Leadership

  • Module 6 — Security & Compliance Architecture (Zero-trust, threat modeling, compliance, secure CI/CD)
  • Module 7 — AI Systems Design & Integration (LLM integration, RAG, ML reliability, AI governance)
  • Module 8 — Architecture Documentation & Leadership (ADRs, C4 diagrams, technical communication)


Please indicate in your application which area fits you best. If you have overlapping skills, don’t hesitate to apply and indicate it in your application. Submit all resumes or CV's in English.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy is an educational platform that helps experienced software developers stay at the forefront of technological innovation. We create specialized courses that teach professionals how to effectively use AI tools in real-world development workflows (AI Assited Programming).

Our programs are designed to help engineers critically and productively apply artificial intelligence in their professional work, improving code quality, development speed, and overall work efficiency.

Our mission is to provide engineers with access to cutting-edge knowledge in AI-assisted development and help them become leaders in the new era of programming.

Who are we looking for?

We are building a talent pool of experienced developers and technical experts for ongoing roles as Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts in our AI-assisted programming educational program.

We are looking for specialists across the following languages and platforms: Golang, Kotlin, Swift, C++, Mobile Development (Android / iOS), and other languages.

A strong candidate doesn't just know their language deeply — they actively use AI-assisted development tools in their daily workflow. We prioritize hands-on experience with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI coding assistants. The ability to teach others how to integrate these tools effectively into real development work is what sets our instructors apart.

These are Talent Pool positions — we continuously review applications and build our roster of experts. This means there may not be an immediate opening at the time you apply, but strong candidates will be added to our talent pool and contacted as relevant opportunities arise.

You can join us on a part-time basis, contributing as an instructor leading live sessions and workshops, as a course author creating learning materials, or as a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development.

Apply now — we review applications on an ongoing basis. Our selection process is fully asynchronous and designed to respect your time:

  1. Application Review — we evaluate your profile against our current needs
  2. Async Video Interview — a short self-recorded interview (10–15 minutes max)
  3. Test Assignment — approximately 1 hour to complete
  4. Talent Pool — finalists are added to our active roster of vetted experts
  5. Hiring Manager & Tech Expert Call — once a relevant position opens, we invite you to a live interview with our team
  6. Offer - We extend offer to you for a relevant position, upon the recruitment process is successfull


Please submit your resume in English.
