details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to own product security end to end — from threat modelling and secure design reviews to vulnerability management and security controls embedded into CI/CD.

You will work closely with product and platform teams to make security part of the engineering process, building secure defaults and helping prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production without slowing development down.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow-up.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
  • Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
  • Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
  • Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
  • Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
  • Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
  • Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day-to-day work.
  • Address security risks specific to AI and LLM-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
  • Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
  • Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
  • Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
  • Hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
  • Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and auditors.
  • Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or above.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building a DevSecOps practice from scratch.
  • Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
  • Hands-on penetration testing experience.
  • Experience securing LLM-powered or AI products.
  • Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
  • Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 4000-6000 EUR Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

• Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow-up.
  • Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
  • Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
  • Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
  • Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
  • Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
  • Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
  • Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day-to-day work.
  • Address security risks specific to AI and LLM-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
  • Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
  • Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
  • Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
  • Hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
  • Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and auditors.
  • Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or above.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building a DevSecOps practice from scratch.
  • Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
  • Hands-on penetration testing experience.
  • Experience securing LLM-powered or AI products.
  • Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
  • Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

details.value:
• A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 4000-6000 EUR Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

details.value:
📚TripleTen es la Edtech #1 en Estados Unidos.

Fundada en 2019, somos una empresa multicultural; actualmente tenemos +25,000 estudiantes activos en todas partes del mundo. Nuestros bootcamps garantizan casi el 80% de empleabilidad durante los 45-60 días posteriores a la graduación.

🥇Fuimos reconocidos en 2023 y el 2024, como el bootcamp tecnológico mas importante de la región.

El equipo de ventas de América Latina está conformado por grandes seres humanos, expertos en su área, líderes que buscan el aprendizaje, desarrollo y crecimiento de cada uno de los integrantes de su equipo.

Estamos buscando Consultores Comerciales Senior listos para romper las metas y liderar la transformación profesional de estudiantes mexicanos.

Este rol requiere excelentes habilidades de comunicación (español nativo), una gran perspicacia para las ventas consultivas de alto valor y alta capacidad para establecer una buena relación con los posibles estudiantes. Buscamos profesionales que dominen ventas de productos premium y sepan convertir objeciones en oportunidades.

¿Estás listo para dolarizar tus ingresos, cambiar tu vida profesional y la de nuestros futuros estudiantes?

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Presentar y vender nuestros bootcamps tecnológicos de alto valor (programas de $3,000-$8,000 USD) utilizando argumentos sólidos a posibles estudiantes mexicanos.
  • Llegar a los clientes potenciales a través de presentaciones online consultivas (videollamadas) y de llamadas telefónicas de seguimiento.
  • Identificar las necesidades profesionales, problemas e intereses de los clientes y resolver sus dudas con enfoque educativo.
  • Gestionar el ciclo completo de venta desde el primer contacto hasta el cierre y la matrícula.
  • Alcanzar y superar los objetivos y resultados de ventas acordados mensualmente.
  • Trabajo con CRM HubSpot para gestión de pipeline y seguimiento de leads.
  • No hacemos llamadas en frío - todos los leads son inbound precalificados.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Experiencia comprobable en cierre de ventas B2C de productos intangibles y/o ventas consultivas de high ticket por más de 2 años (Excluyente).
  • Historial demostrable con tickets superiores a $1,000 USD (equivalente a $20,000 MXN mínimo). Experiencia con productos de $30,000-$100,000 MXN es altamente valorada.
  • Capacidad para gestionar acuerdos de principio a fin y cerrar tratos exitosamente, preferiblemente en sectores como EdTech, formación ejecutiva, seguros de vida/gastos médicos mayores, bienes raíces, SaaS, productos financieros premium y productos de alto valor tanto en B2C como en B2B2C.
  • Dominio del manejo de objeciones sin recurrir automáticamente a descuentos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y de atención al cliente con enfoque consultivo.
  • Profesional altamente motivado y orientado a objetivos, con un historial comprobado en ventas y cumplimiento de cuotas.
  • Mentalidad analítica - capacidad de trackear KPIs y optimizar la conversión.
  • Experiencia con CRM (HubSpot es un plus significativo).

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Trabajo 100% remoto y a tiempo completo.
  • Base de 500 USD + comisiones ilimitadas. Pago total en promedio, incluidas las comisiones, es de aproximadamente 2,500 USD. Si tienes un alto rendimiento, puedes ganar $3,500 USD mensuales ya que tenemos comisiones ilimitadas.
  • Compensación 100% en dólares estadounidenses - protege tus ingresos de la devaluación.
  • Experiencia laboral internacional en una de las empresas más reconocidas del mercado EdTech global.
  • Plan de carrera definido: Closer → Team Lead → Supervisor → Country Manager (progresión en 8-18 meses).
  • Capacitación constante en metodologías de venta consultiva y conocimiento de producto.
  • Trabajarás con estudiantes mexicanos - entiendes el contexto cultural y las necesidades del mercado local.
  • Herramientas profesionales: HubSpot CRM, plataformas de videollamada, materiales de venta actualizados.
  • Horarios: 5 días de trabajo (1 día del fin de semana) y dos días de descanso (1 día de fin de semana y 1 durante la semana, que puede ser: martes, miércoles o jueves), con horario: de 11:30 a 21:00 hs CDMX.

El seguimiento y actualización del proceso es vía correo electrónico, por favor revisa tu carpeta de spam. El próximo paso será una reunión con nuestro reclutador.

En el momento no consideramos candidatos de Venezuela (ya que no poseemos proveedores de pagos en el país).

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy designs hands-on learning experiences that help professionals move beyond individual AI productivity. Our programs enable learners to redesign real workflows around AI and agents, scale these practices across teams, and adopt AI safely and responsibly when it affects decisions or sensitive processes.

We are looking for an experienced automation and AI adoption practitioner to join us as a Subject Matter Expert and Course Author. You will transform your hands-on experience into practical learning content, including frameworks, real-world case studies, reusable templates, exercises, and methodologies that professionals can apply to their own workflows.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Design and author the course curriculum as a subject-matter expert.
  • Work with the course team to shape module outlines, lessons, practical exercises, and competency-based learning outcomes.
  • Build and refine case studies, templates, and checklists that participants can reuse in their own processes.
  • Translate real AI and automation implementation experience into clear, practical learning frameworks.
  • Review course materials for technical accuracy and practical relevance.
  • Where live delivery is included, facilitate sessions and provide structured feedback on participants’ workflow redesign, scaling, and control decisions.
  • Keep the course current as automation tools, agent practices, and AI adoption and control standards evolve.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must Have

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in automation, process engineering, or a comparable role involving the redesign of real workflows around AI or agents—not only the use of AI as a personal productivity tool.
  • Practical experience taking an AI or automation pilot through the full lifecycle: scoping it, documenting the practice, enabling other people to adopt it, and measuring whether it created meaningful business value.
  • Practical experience introducing guardrails around AI-assisted work, such as QA processes, human accountability, review boundaries, or domain-specific controls.
  • Hands-on experience with agent or workflow automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience driving AI or automation adoption across teams or organizations, including measuring value and communicating it to stakeholders.
  • A solid understanding of where full automation is and is not appropriate, with the ability to explain and defend that judgment.
  • Excellent communication and knowledge-structuring skills, with the ability to turn technical decisions into frameworks that non-technical professionals can apply.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Availability to collaborate within European time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Deep hands-on expertise in the Gemini ecosystem, particularly Gems, Workspace Studio automations, and NotebookLM.
  • Experience working with AI and automation in a corporate Google Workspace environment.
  • Experience authoring courses, playbooks, technical documentation, or structured enablement materials.
  • Experience conducting workshops, webinars, corporate training, or other knowledge-sharing sessions.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Remote, part-time collaboration under a service agreement.
  • A workload of approximately 10–15 hours per week.
  • Compensation of $40–100 per hour.
  • An opportunity to shape a practical course focused on real AI and automation adoption challenges.
  • The ability to translate your professional experience into reusable frameworks and learning experiences for business professionals.
  • Close collaboration with the Nebius Academy course team.
  • The opportunity to influence how organizations redesign workflows, scale AI practices, and introduce responsible controls.

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is an online teaching platform that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.

details.name: Description
details.value:
📚A TripleTen é uma escola online que ajuda pessoas, independentemente de sua experiência prévia, a desenvolver competências em áreas de tecnologia como Software Engineering, Data Analysis, Data Science, Business Intelligence e QA Engineering de forma acessível, prática e viável. Nossa missão é garantir que cada estudante tenha a oportunidade de aprender uma nova profissão com sucesso e se tornar um profissional valioso para a indústria de tecnologia.

Estamos em expansão no Brasil e buscamos Closers com perfil consultivo, senso de dono e vontade de crescer em um ambiente de alta performance, vendendo um produto que realmente transforma vidas.

details.value:

  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa e boa organização comercial

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar pelo menos um sábado por mês

details.name: What we can offer you

details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.


We are seeking a hands-on Content Growth Manager to lead end-to-end asset production and distribution across the US region. You will leverage AI tools like Claude to prototype interactive features, manage freelance teams within budget, and optimize touchpoint analytics to ship three high-value, revenue-driving projects a month.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Ship monthly growth projects: Launch 3 end-to-end projects every month designed directly to drive user conversion and paid enrollments.
  • Build interactive assets independently: Use AI tools like Claude to prototype custom calculators, skills reports, and pre-payment checks without waiting on developers or designers.
  • Source & manage external talent: Find, hire, and direct freelancers, video editors, and contractors within budget to get projects across the finish line.
  • Manage end-to-end distribution: Deploy and promote assets across all core growth channels, including the website, email marketing, social platforms, and sales collateral.
  • Set up touchpoint analytics: Build robust attribution tracking to accurately measure content engagement, audience growth, and funnel drop-offs.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Proven track record: A portfolio or case studies showing end-to-end projects you’ve personally built and shipped.
  • Deep audience insight: Real understanding of US adult learners (ages 35–55) and what content actually delivers value to them.
  • AI fluency: Ability to build interactive tools independently using AI (like Claude) without relying on developers or designers.
  • Resourceful execution: Experience sourcing contractors, negotiating budgets, and pulling resources together without waiting for assigned help.
  • Fluent English (B2+): Strong written and spoken communication tailored to a US market.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Competitive compensation: Market-rate salary plus performance bonuses tied to project launches and enrollment metrics.
  • 100% remote flexibility: Freedom to work from anywhere .
  • Full tech & AI stack access: Uncapped access to leading AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, low-code builders) plus dedicated budget for freelancers and contractors.
  • High autonomy, zero red tape: Complete freedom to test, vibe-code, and ship projects without bureaucratic approval loops.
  • Impact & ownership: Direct influence on revenue and product strategy alongside a fast-moving, high-performing team.

We are looking for a Creative Producer within the User Acquisition Marketing team to own the end-to-end production, testing, and scaling of performance-driven marketing creatives.


This role sits at the intersection of marketing production, creative execution, and performance analytics, ensuring that creatives are produced efficiently, tested systematically, and scaled based on data and results - not subjective taste.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Own the full lifecycle of marketing creatives within the Marketing Production team
  • Translate performance and acquisition goals into clear creative briefs and hypotheses
  • Oversee production of marketing assets (video, static, UGC) for paid channels
  • Analyze creative performance and identify opportunities for iteration and scaling
  • Work with key metrics to guide creative decisions
  • Build scalable creative frameworks and variation systems
  • Ensure fast and predictable production timelines aligned with marketing needs
  • Collaborate closely with UA team and content production team
  • Document creative learnings, best practices, and performance insights

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Required Experience & Skills:

  • Strong understanding of performance marketing and paid acquisition channels
  • Conversational English (ability to communicate effectively with international teams)
  • Hands-on experience working with key metrics: CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS
  • Experience managing creative testing, iteration, and scaling
  • Ability to manage production pipelines and multiple creative iterations
  • Data-driven mindset with a strong focus on efficiency and results

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience using AI tools for creative production or optimization
  • Experience working with the Tier-1 markets
  • Structured thinking

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Remote and flexible cooperation.
  • Convenient digital office with collaboration tools like Slack, Miro, Notion.
  • Professional freedom, where we trust your experience instead of wasting each other's time and effort micromanaging.
  • International team of professionals.

We're looking for a CRM Systems & Automation Manager to own our customer-facing systems and automate operational processes across Student Onboarding and Student Success.


This is a cross-functional role combining business analysis, process design, system administration, and technical implementation. You'll work closely with Product, Operations, Engineering, and external vendors to build scalable workflows, reduce manual work, optimize software costs, and ensure our systems run reliably.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Own and continuously improve our CRM ecosystem, primarily HubSpot and Planhat.
  • Design, build, and maintain automations using Make or similar workflow automation platforms.
  • Connect and manage integrations across CRM, telephony, and other business-critical systems.
  • Administer and optimise the software stack used by Product and Operations teams.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, eliminate manual tasks, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Research, evaluate, and implement new software solutions that align with business needs and scale with growth.
  • Monitor system performance, enhance reliability, and drive software cost optimisation.
  • Partner with Engineering to define technical requirements, prioritise improvements, and deliver new capabilities.
  • Manage relationships with software vendors, including procurement, negotiations, and ongoing collaboration.
  • Produce clear documentation, process maps, and internal knowledge resources.
  • Present system enhancements, automation initiatives, and process improvements to cross-functional stakeholders.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:

¡Estamos buscando un/a Especialista en Retención de Clientes y Ventas para unirse a nuestro creciente equipo en América Latina!

Este es un rol clave que requiere sólidas habilidades de ventas, inteligencia emocional y la capacidad de retener estudiantes, guiándolos a través de sus desafíos y resaltando el verdadero valor de continuar su educación con nosotros.


Porfavor diligenciar su CV actualizado

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Gestionar de principio a fin las conversaciones con estudiantes que estén considerando cancelar su programa o solicitar un reembolso, utilizando habilidades de venta consultiva para comprender su situación y encontrar la solución más adecuada.
  • Manejar objeciones y negociaciones, incluyendo conversaciones difíciles, sensibles o escaladas, manteniendo siempre un enfoque empático y orientado a soluciones.
  • Identificar oportunidades para aportar mayor valor al estudiante y presentar alternativas de manera estratégica, según cada situación.
  • Contactar proactivamente a estudiantes que presenten señales de riesgo de abandono y trabajar para encontrar soluciones que favorezcan su continuidad en el programa.
  • Cumplir de forma consistente con los objetivos y KPIs individuales de retención.
  • Utilizar el CRM para registrar de manera precisa y oportuna las interacciones, acuerdos y resultados de cada caso.
  • Contribuir con ideas y feedback para mejorar la experiencia de retención y optimizar los procesos internos.
  • Colaborar con otros equipos cuando sea necesario para encontrar soluciones adecuadas para los estudiantes.
  • Participar activamente en capacitaciones y aplicar el feedback recibido para desarrollar continuamente tus habilidades de ventas, negociación y retención.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Experiencia comprobada en ventas (mínimo 2 años cerrando ventas consultivas en B2C/B2B2C, preferentemente en el sector financiero o educativo).
  • Experiencia en Retención.
  • Nivel avanzado de español (C2).
  • Nivel básico/intermedio de Inglés
  • Fuertes habilidades de persuasión y negociación; alta inteligencia emocional.
  • Capacidad para manejar objeciones de manera efectiva y convertir desafíos en oportunidades.
  • Altamente organizado/a, proactivo/a y cómodo/a trabajando con sistemas CRM.
  • Conocimiento general de la industria EdTech.
  • Experiencia laboral en mesa de ayuda, call center y/o profesiones relacionadas con atención al cliente.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Horario: Trabajo 100% remoto. Lunes a Viernes.
  • Salario: Hasta 1,800 dolares mensuales.
  • Desarrollo profesional en un equipo internacional.
  • Oficina digital cómoda. Usamos herramientas modernas como Slack, Notion, Zoom, HubSpot, HiBob para una colaboración fluida.
  • Equipo diverso y unido distribuido por EE. UU., Latinoamérica ¡y más!

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Host regular live Q&A sessions to help students unblock and progress confidently
  • Offer personalized support through 1:1 video calls to answer questions and guide assignments
  • Occasionally respond to student questions via direct messages
  • Lead live lessons on core program topics and industry-relevant skills
  • Share your professional insights and best practices to support the learning community
  • Review student projects and provide feedback based on program standards
  • Write clear, actionable feedback to help students improve and meet expectations
  • Support students in text by explaining concepts, troubleshooting code, and clarifying project or review questions

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
We require at least 3 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, with knowledge in:

  • Networking & Architecture: Understanding of flat vs. segmented networks, DMZs, and blast radius reduction.
  • Authentication & Access Abuse: Ability to identify risks related to privileged access, RDP usage, and mass data exports.
  • Incident Analysis: Experience investigating failed logins, password resets, and administrative account creation using MITRE ATT&CK tactics.
  • Log Analysis: Ability to analyze logs and identify suspicious patterns.
  • Python Programming: Ability to develop scripts for log processing, occurrence counting, and extracting relevant information.
  • Ability to explain complex topics clearly to beginners.
  • Patience and empathy toward students who are new to cybersecurity.
  • Availability to dedicate between 12 and 20 hours per week to the project, with a flexible schedule that may occasionally include weekends.
  • B1 English level and strong Spanish proficiency.
  • Ability to answer beginner-level questions with patience and practical examples.


Nice to have:

  • Previous teaching experience.
  • Experience guiding beginners one-on-one with clear, step-by-step instruction.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:

details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.


We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.


This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.


Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.


Format: Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 5 to 15 hrs/week.


Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.
  • Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
  • Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Depth across the FDE spine: customer discovery and design sessions, scoping and delivery planning under ambiguity, stakeholder management without formal authority; LLM and agent systems in production (prompting, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI, guardrails, evals, RAG over enterprise data); APIs and integrations (REST, webhooks, JSON/GraphQL), Python, and deployment on at least one major cloud.
  • Can explain why an architecture or scoping decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
  • Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.


Preferred experience:

  • Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
  • Has worked embedded within a customer team as their primary technical resource, or held a customer-facing engineering role (solutions engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant).
  • Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI) and MCP-based tool integrations into client systems.
  • Work experience at a recognizable company.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

• Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.
  • Run 1:1 sessions and tech mock interviews for students working through projects.
  • Review student projects against rubrics, including the client-facing side of the work: scoping decisions, demos, and how they explain a system to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Set the technical standard for a team of supporting instructors who cover questions and first-line review, and act as their escalation point.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Depth across the FDE spine: customer discovery and design sessions, scoping and delivery planning under ambiguity, stakeholder management without formal authority; LLM and agent systems in production (prompting, tool/function calling, orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI, guardrails, evals, RAG over enterprise data); APIs and integrations (REST, webhooks, JSON/GraphQL), Python, and deployment on at least one major cloud.
  • Can explain why an architecture or scoping decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's work live.
  • Strong technical communication: translating between technical and business audiences, comfortable leading a live session, whiteboarding a solution, and writing clear, specific review feedback.
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work.


Preferred experience:

  • Has taught, mentored, or run technical sessions before: internal tech talks, onboarding, mentoring engineers, bootcamp or workshop instruction.
  • Has worked embedded within a customer team as their primary technical resource, or held a customer-facing engineering role (solutions engineer, solutions architect, technical consultant).
  • Production experience with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI) and MCP-based tool integrations into client systems.
  • Work experience at a recognizable company.
  • Familiarity with online education platforms or running programs.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Fully remote work, with live sessions scheduled within US afternoon and evening hours.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.


We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: hosts the group live events, reviews the work, runs the solution design and delivery reviews, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you. The curriculum is built by a team of senior authors.


This is a teaching and reviewing role. You'll be the senior technical presence students learn from week to week. You'll run group live events, give real engineering feedback on student deployment deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.


Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.


Format: Group live events, 1:1s, and workshops timed around US Eastern Time – mostly 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM ET. Estimated 5 to 15 hrs/week.


Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for a Learning Experience Designer to join Nebius Academy’s B2B Curriculum team for an initial three-month project, with the possibility of extension.

You will design and adapt practical learning programs for corporate clients, with a strong focus on technical content: agentic AI development, learning experiences for software developers, and other complex technical skills. You will work with subject-matter experts to turn business needs into clear learning paths, hands-on practice, and assessments.

This is a full-time, remote engagement under a service agreement. The initial contract is for three months. Any extension will depend on the team’s plans and business needs.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Own the end-to-end development of new B2B courses, from learning needs analysis and high-level design to final course documentation, in collaboration with Product Managers and subject-matter experts.
  • Build course Skill Trees and map learning outcomes across the course, modules, and individual lessons.
  • Create educational content, practice exercises, assessments, and learning aids based on materials provided by subject-matter experts.
  • Prepare clear briefs for designers and video editors, and develop outlines and facilitator materials for workshops, seminars, and other live formats.
  • Analyze each client’s learning needs, business goals, workflows, tools, operational constraints, and learner profiles together with Product Managers and client stakeholders.
  • Customize learning activities, case studies, learning paths, curriculum structure, and schedules to reflect authentic client tasks and the needs of different roles.
  • Continuously improve the learning experience by auditing cognitive load, motivation, difficulty, and alignment with learning outcomes; use learner feedback and expert recommendations to update content and maintain an improvement backlog.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Must have:

  • At least three years of experience as an Instructional Designer, Learning Experience Designer, Learning Content Developer, Program Designer, or in a comparable role.
  • Proven experience applying modern learning experience design models, methodologies, and frameworks to the development of complex skills.
  • Experience structuring end-to-end learning experiences, including building Skill Trees and Learning Journey Maps and mapping learning outcomes.
  • Ability to create different forms of educational content, including long reads, projects, practice tasks, infographics, and other learning aids.
  • Experience designing and integrating skills and knowledge assessments into a course.
  • English proficiency at C1 level (strong B2 users with a good fit in other requirements are welcome to apply, too).

Nice to have:

  • Strong familiarity with popular AI tools (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Claude Design). Experience creating your own agents or workflows, or some familiarity with coding, is a strong plus.
  • Experience adapting curricula for B2B clients based on their business goals, workflows, learner profiles, and operational constraints.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Compensation of USD 2,500–3,000 gross per month under a service agreement.
  • Remote, full-time collaboration.
  • Performance reviews twice a year and a bonus system.
  • Digital office. We use modern digital tools such as Miro, Notion, and Slack to keep our teamwork smooth.
  • Professional autonomy. We trust your expertise and do not believe in micromanagement.
  • Room to grow. Our product is expanding rapidly, creating opportunities to take on new challenges and develop professionally.
  • A diverse and close-knit international team working across Europe, Asia, and Latin America.

details.name: Description
details.value:
📚 TripleTen es una empresa EdTech que diseña y desarrolla programas de formación tecnológica para los mercados de Estados Unidos y América Latina. Llevamos más de cinco años enseñando a personas sin experiencia previa en tecnología, a través de programas por cohortes en nuestra propia plataforma y currícula, desarrollada en asociación con Nebius AI. Nuestro equipo es 100% remoto y está distribuido globalmente, y atendemos a una amplia base de estudiantes activos en ambas regiones.

Estamos buscando un/a Líder de Equipo de Ventas B2C, dinámico y orientado a resultados, para liderar a nuestro equipo LATAM en la venta de nuestro producto en el mercado latinoamericano.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Cumplir la cuota de ventas del equipo liderando a un equipo de hasta 12 asesores de ventas.
  • Contratar, capacitar, motivar y controlar el desempeño de tu equipo de ventas.
  • Implementar cambios en el flujo de trabajo junto con el Head of Sales y el Sales Country Manager.
  • Realizar capacitaciones grupales y sesiones de coaching individual para los miembros del equipo.
  • Cumplir los objetivos de ventas del mercado LATAM.
  • Asegurar que todos los procesos y normativas sean seguidos por el equipo (gestión de leads en el CRM, uso correcto del script).
  • Entregar reportes sobre el desempeño del equipo.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Dominio del idioma español.
  • Experiencia en telemarketing o ventas B2C (3+ años).
  • Experiencia en gestión de equipos de ventas (3+ años).
  • Habilidades de análisis de datos.
  • Experiencia en coaching y acompañamiento de equipos de ventas.
  • Excelentes habilidades blandas y de comunicación.
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM.
  • Profesional altamente motivado y orientado a objetivos, con historial comprobado en gestión de ventas.
  • Experiencia en Educación, EdTech, Tech, Marketing, SaaS B2C o Seguros es un plus.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Pago base de 1700 USD Gross + comisiones. El pago total puede llegar hasta 3000 USD Gross al mes.
  • Posición 100% remota y a tiempo completo.
  • Experiencia laboral internacional en una de las empresas más reconocidas del mercado.
  • Horario de trabajo: 5 días laborales, dos días de descanso a la semana.

En el momento no consideramos candidatos de Venezuela (ya que no poseemos proveedores de pagos en el país).

details.value:

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. 

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career. 

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry. 

TripleTen is a remote first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment.

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Marketing Manager to own and drive a portfolio of marketing projects, from scoping through launch and results tracking. This role collaborates closely with our Marketing, Content, and Product teams to identify opportunities, run initiatives end-to-end, and turn insights into measurable results.

The best candidates for this position combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, are comfortable managing several projects at once, and know how to turn a messy problem into a clear plan.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Own and drive multiple marketing projects end-to-end, from scoping to launch to results tracking.
  • Analyze market and audience feedback, turning insights into actionable marketing initiatives.
  • Develop and execute content and community strategies in collaboration with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Establish and grow brand presence across social media, online communities, and other digital channels.
  • Build guidelines and playbooks to support consistent brand messaging across channels.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve complex, cross-functional issues.
  • Track project performance and report on key metrics to leadership.
  • Identify and act on opportunities to improve brand visibility and audience engagement.
  • Set up and manage engagement processes for key audience segments (students, graduates, alumni, etc.).
  • Scout, test, and scale new channels and platforms to reach and grow our audience.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
You're a strong, hands-on marketing generalist who loves building things yourself, not just managing others, with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience running marketing projects end-to-end.
  • Strong background working with consumer-facing brands.
  • Excellent English communication skills for global audience engagement.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to measure and optimize project and campaign metrics.
  • Experience across several marketing disciplines: content, social media, and community.
  • Strategic thinking combined with tactical execution capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with AI in at least one area — building products, funnels, designs, copywriting workflows, or agents.
  • Proven ability to manage sensitive or public-facing situations effectively.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in education technology or similar consumer services.
  • Content creation and digital marketing skills.
  • Crisis communication experience.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Base compensation of $3000/month plus annual bonus.
  • Fully remote collaboration.
  • High autonomy to explore, test, and improve marketing processes.
  • Work alongside an experienced, global marketing team.
  • Room to grow your scope as projects prove out.

🌈🚀 We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly responsible Quality Control Specialist to evaluate sales team performance through the review of video and audio calls. This role focuses on identifying errors, detecting best practices, and ensuring adherence to internal sales standards. The specialist will provide structured feedback and contribute directly to improving overall call quality and closing performance.

The ideal candidate has experience in sales or customer service, demonstrates strong analytical listening skills, and maintains a high level of objectivity and professionalism. This is a part-time position with flexible hours.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Review Sales Calls: Evaluate video and audio recordings of sales representatives, ensuring compliance with quality standards and internal scripts.
  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Work with our internal AI tools to analyze recorded calls. Since calls are processed through AI, interest or basic ability in creating effective prompts is highly valued.
  • Identify Errors and Opportunities: Detect mistakes, missed opportunities, or exemplary behaviors, documenting each finding clearly and accurately.
  • Quality Reporting: Prepare concise quality reports that support coaching, improvement plans, and performance evaluations.
  • Support Performance-Based Bonuses: Validate and confirm errors found, contributing to the calculation of quality-related incentives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Provide insights to supervisors regarding recurring issues or training needs.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Professional Background

  • Experience in sales or customer service is required.
  • Previous exposure to quality control, auditing calls, or similar functions is a plus but not mandatory.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
  • Excellent listening skills and ability to detect deviations in scripts, process adherence, and communication style.
  • Objective and unbiased judgment in evaluating performance.
  • Ability to provide clear, concise, and professional written feedback.
  • Interest in AI tools: Curiosity or enthusiasm for working with AI call-analysis systems. Ability to craft simple prompts or willingness to learn is an advantage.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Flexible 20 hours per week (can be combined with a full-time job).
  • Base salary: USD $300 monthly.
  • Performance bonus: Up to $50 monthly, based on the number of validated and confirmed errors identified.
  • Work 100% remotely.
  • Join a fast-growing, intercultural EdTech team.

Work Schedule:

  • Part-time: 4 hours per day.
  • Flexible schedule; preference for availability between 1:00 PM and 5:00 PM (Colombia time).

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is an award-winning online school in the technology bootcamp space. Our mission is to help people transform their lives and succeed in tech. We offer flexible learning, career mentorship, resume and portfolio support — and we proudly maintain an 87% job placement rate across our Web Development, QA, Data Analytics, and Data Science programs.


The Partnership Lead is responsible for building, scaling, and leading the Partnerships function across the US and LATAM, with a primary focus on Career partnerships and the US market. This is a hands-on leadership role combining strategic ownership with direct execution. The Partnership Lead will define partnership strategy, build and optimize the partnership pipeline, establish scalable outreach processes, and support the development of the Partnership Management team.


The role will directly manage Partnership Managers across regions, working closely with Career Leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to build partnerships that primarily support Career outcomes (employment and Industry Experience), while also driving strategic partnership opportunities for other business functions, including Marketing and Product initiatives.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
1. Partnership Strategy & Growth

  • Own the overall partnership strategy across the US and LATAM, with the primary focus on Career partnerships while supporting strategic partnership initiatives for other business functions when appropriate.
  • Define partnership priorities, target segments, and outreach strategies.
  • Build scalable partnership acquisition and retention processes.
  • Continuously optimize partnership performance based on data and results.


2. Partnership Development

  • Personally develop relationships with strategic partners, primarily in the US market.
  • Build and maintain a sustainable pipeline of Tier-1 and high-impact employers.
  • Lead negotiations with strategic partners.
  • Develop partnerships supporting Career Services, employment, Industry Experience, employer engagement, and cross-functional business initiatives, including Marketing and Product partnerships where relevant.
  • Identify and validate new partnership opportunities that create long-term value for the business.


3. Team Leadership & Development

  • Directly manage Partnership Managers across the US and LATAM.
  • Coach and mentor the team through regular pipeline reviews, outreach strategy discussions, and performance coaching.
  • Support the professional development of Partnership Managers by sharing best practices and providing ongoing guidance.
  • Ensure consistent partnership management standards and operational processes across regions.


4. Pipeline & Performance Management

  • Monitor partnership pipeline health and conversion metrics.
  • Review outreach quality, messaging, and engagement strategies.
  • Identify bottlenecks and adjust partnership strategy when necessary.
  • Establish reporting, KPI tracking, and operational visibility across the Partnerships function.


5. Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Career Leadership, Product, Marketing, Student Experience, and other business stakeholders to identify and develop partnership opportunities aligned with company priorities.
  • Align partnership initiatives with Career strategy and broader business objectives.
  • Support the launch of new Career offerings and other strategic company initiatives requiring external partnerships or employer engagement.
  • Represent the Partnerships function in strategic planning and cross-functional initiatives.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
Required

  • Proven experience building employer or strategic partnership functions from scratch.
  • Demonstrated success securing strategic partnerships with large organizations, preferably Tier-1 employers.
  • Experience building and maintaining long-term partnership pipelines rather than one-off collaborations.
  • Experience with non-revenue partnership models (Career, Education, Industry Experience, Talent, Community, Marketing, CSR, or similar).
  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing partnership teams.
  • Strong analytical mindset with experience using partnership metrics to drive decisions.
  • Excellent English communication skills.


Nice to Have

  • Existing Tier-1 employer network, particularly in the US market.
  • Experience in EdTech, HRTech, recruiting, workforce development, or talent partnerships.
  • Experience building global or multi-regional partnership functions.
  • Experience coaching and developing junior Partnership Managers.

details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓At TripleTen, we're building an international platform of digital re-skilling products to help people from diverse backgrounds learn new professions and build sustainable careers in tech.


Our program graduates have landed jobs at top companies like Tesla, Spotify, PlayStation, Google, and Microsoft. So far, over 5,000 students have chosen TripleTen, and hundreds of new students are joining us each month. We believe everyone can jumpstart a new career, which is why we produce quality educational content and offer intensive courses in tech complete with full access to an interactive platform, code reviews, and support from industry practitioners.


We're looking for a hands-on Product Manager who combines strong Growth and Product expertise.


This role is ideal for a product generalist who is comfortable moving between product discovery, product optimization, and cross-functional business execution. You'll work across the entire product lifecycle—from validating new opportunities and finding product-market fit to improving onboarding, retention, and operational excellence.


This is a highly autonomous role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, makes decisions based on data, and takes ownership of business outcomes rather than simply delivering features.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Identify new product opportunities through market research, customer interviews, and JTBD analysis.
  • Validate product ideas, drive product-market fit, and develop positioning, value propositions, pricing, and go-to-market recommendations.
  • Own key product initiatives across onboarding, activation, retention, subscriptions, billing, and monetization.
  • Conduct user research, define hypotheses, run experiments, and use insights to improve product performance.
  • Analyze product metrics, identify growth opportunities, and prioritize initiatives based on business impact.
  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Operations to deliver cross-functional initiatives.
  • Design and improve processes at the intersection of product and business operations, ensuring scalable execution.
  • Distinguish whether problems should be solved through product improvements, operational changes, or both, and drive the appropriate solution.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with ownership of both product discovery and product growth initiatives.
  • Experience launching new products or business directions, including market research, customer discovery, PMF validation, positioning, pricing, and commercialization.
  • Strong experience managing core product initiatives such as onboarding, retention, subscriptions, billing, and monetization.
  • Deep understanding of product analytics and data-driven decision making, with experience defining metrics and measuring impact.
  • Experience conducting user research, JTBD interviews, and hypothesis-driven experimentation.
  • Strong operational mindset with the ability to design and optimize cross-functional processes.
  • Proven ability to work effectively across Product, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Comfortable working in fast-changing environments with high levels of ambiguity and ownership.
  • Excellent analytical thinking, communication, and prioritization skills.
  • Fluent English.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Direct impact on revenue and core business metrics.
  • High autonomy to explore, test, and improve processes.
  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote collaboration.
  • Work alongside an experienced, global professional team.

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for Onboarding Sales Trainer to join our Sales Training team and own the onboarding and development of new sales hires working with the US market.

This is a hands-on role for a sales professional with leadership, coaching, or training experience who will lead two-week onboarding programs for new hires, develop practical sales skills, and maintain training materials. The role is fully remote, supports our LATAM-based sales team serving the US market, and requires native-level Spanish, fluent English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Lead end-to-end onboarding for new sales hires, running a structured two-week onboarding program for our LATAM-based sales team working with the US market.
  • Train regular cohorts of new hires — currently around 4–5 people once a month, with cohort sizes expected to grow to 10+ people as the team scales.
  • Develop practical sales skills, including discovery, probing, objection handling, closing, follow-up, negotiation, customer communication, and working with different customer profiles.
  • Train new hires on our product, sales processes, and day-to-day tools, including CRM systems, telephony, WhatsApp-based communication tools, and other digital sales platforms.
  • Run highly interactive training sessions using role plays, mock sales calls, real-life scenarios, demonstrations, practical exercises, and continuous feedback to make sure trainees can apply what they learn in real conversations.
  • Assess each trainee’s progress throughout the two weeks, identify individual gaps, adapt your coaching approach, and provide clear feedback on their readiness before handing them over to their Sales Supervisor.
  • Partner closely with Sales Supervisors and managers to ensure a smooth handover, share feedback on each trainee, and jointly investigate performance gaps if a new hire struggles after onboarding.
  • Maintain and improve onboarding materials, including presentations, scripts, exercises, guides, and process documentation, keeping them accurate and up to date whenever sales processes or operations change.
  • Use AI and modern productivity tools to create and improve training materials, scripts, presentations, exercises, and other onboarding content more efficiently.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Hands-on sales experience. You should understand the full sales process from your own practical experience, not only from managing or training others.
  • 2+ years of leadership, team supervision, coaching, or sales management experience, ideally working directly with sales teams.
  • Native-level Spanish and fluent English, with the confidence to train, coach, and provide feedback in both languages.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills — you can explain complex concepts simply, keep a group engaged, and adapt your communication style to different levels of experience.
  • Patience, empathy, and emotional maturity. You are comfortable working with struggling trainees, handling difficult conversations, receiving critical feedback, and resolving disagreements constructively.
  • Strong ownership and accountability. You can recognize when something is not working, admit mistakes, review the situation objectively, and adjust your approach rather than becoming defensive or blaming others.
  • Energy and charisma to motivate people, maintain engagement, and create a positive but demanding learning environment.
  • Comfort with digital tools and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including CRM, telephony, messaging, presentation, and online training tools.
  • Ability to work remotely with stable internet connectivity and availability aligned with Colombia working hours.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in B2C sales, especially high-ticket, consultative, or fast-paced sales where discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing happen directly with the customer.
  • Previous experience as a Sales Trainer, Sales Coach, Team Lead, Supervisor, or Sales Manager.
  • Experience coaching or developing underperforming salespeople and helping them improve through practice, feedback, and structured follow-up.
  • Experience working in high-volume sales environments, including call centers or similar teams.
  • Experience creating or maintaining training materials, scripts, presentations, onboarding guides, or process documentation.
  • Experience using AI and modern productivity tools to create or improve training content, scripts, exercises, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with LATAM-based sales teams serving the US market.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 1000-2000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. 

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career. 

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry. 

TripleTen is a remote first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment

Please submit all Resumes / CV's in English.

We are looking for high energy, enthusiastic, and people driven Contract Account Executives for our US b2c sales team working with US Customers. This role collaborates closely with our Sales and Marketing Teams to prospect, qualify, and close new sales. 

The best candidates for this position thrive on positivity, personal accountability, and love the challenge of lateral problem solving.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Operate as a full cycle sales person, qualifying leads all the way to closing the sale and taking payment information
  • Present and articulate TripleTens value proposition, product features and benefits, product direction, and product solutions to customers
  • Work closely with sales managers to close deals, and consistently meet or exceeding quotas
  • Work closely with the marketing teams to improve the sales pipeline and contribute analysis on wins/losses
  • Maintain accurate documentation of leads worked and the success of leads converted into opportunities using HubSpot
  • Bring a unique element to the team that promotes teamwork, strategy, hustle, and excitement

Weekly Schedule:

  • Option 1: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM (EST) Sunday, 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM (EST) Monday to Thursday
  • Option 2: 9:00 AM (EST) - 6:00 PM (EST) Thursday to Monday

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 2-5 years of b2c sales experience in commission rewarded environments. Preferred industry backgrounds include insurance, real estate, high end retail (phones, tablets, computers, ect), and similar. Experience with selling into the US market is a plus.
  • Demonstrated record of hitting sales and activity quota consistently in previous role
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English
  • Ability to build rapport with leads
  • Sharp business acumen, prior experience using HubSpot preferred
  • Passionate about helping individuals better themselves and their careers
  • Excellent team member who puts the mission above themselves (is focused more on “getting things right” rather than having to “be right”)

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Study best practices of consultative sales on the US market
  • Remote, full-time work with 160h per month loading. 10 hours shifts.
  • Opportunity to expand your international sales experience with US customers
  • Base Compensation ($2000/month) + plus uncapped commission. Commission based on hitting monthly cash in quota. OTE for top performers is up to $6k/monthly.
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom — to make working together seamless
  • Growth. Our product is expanding quickly, so it's a great time to get on board and challenge yourself
  • Internationally distributed team. Exceptional teammates, who love what they do

We are looking for a high energy, consultative Technical Senior Sales Consultant to work with a more advanced audience: experienced tech professionals who already work in the industry and are looking to deepen their expertise, switch specializations, or move into senior and higher paying roles. You'll be selling an advanced program to experienced engineers, so you need to hold a credible, peer-level conversation and be comfortable across the full arc of modern systems engineering (system design and architecture, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems and data, security, and production AI). You won't need to write code, but you must understand these concepts well enough to answer real questions, map the curriculum to the roles and salaries candidates are targeting, and earn the trust of people who have hands-on experience.

The best candidates for this position combine strong consultative sales skills with genuine comfort in technical conversations, and thrive on complex, high value deals rather than high volume transactional sales.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Operate as a full cycle sales consultant, engaging technically experienced prospects, qualifying their goals, and guiding them to a decision
  • Hold credible, informed conversations about technical topics relevant to our advanced courses, without needing to defer every technical question elsewhere
  • Present and articulate TripleTen's value proposition for career advancement and skill deepening, tailored to an audience that already has industry experience
  • Work closely with sales leadership to close complex, higher ticket deals and consistently meet or exceed quota
  • Work closely with marketing to refine messaging and positioning for this more experienced audience
  • Maintain accurate documentation of leads and pipeline progress using HubSpot
  • Bring consultative rigor and technical credibility to a team built around trust and expertise

﻿Weekly Schedule:

11:00 AM - 8:00 PM (EST) Monday to Thursday, 9:00 AM (EST) - 6:00 PM (EST) rotating Friday or Saturday

  • Strong discovery skills - able to diagnose a prospect's goals and gaps before pitching, not lead with a script.
  • Fluent English (C1 or above)
  • Technical background or experience selling to technical buyers is a plus, not a requirement

We are looking for a high energy, consultative Technical Senior Sales Consultant to work with a more advanced audience: experienced tech professionals who already work in the industry and are looking to deepen their expertise, switch specializations, or move into senior and higher paying roles. This is a step above our core B2C sales team. You'll be selling an advanced program to experienced engineers, so you need to hold a credible, peer-level conversation and be comfortable across the full arc of modern systems engineering (system design and architecture, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems and data, security, and production AI). You won't need to write code, but you must understand these concepts well enough to answer real questions, map the curriculum to the roles and salaries candidates are targeting, and earn the trust of people who have hands-on experience.

The best candidates for this position combine strong consultative sales skills with genuine comfort in technical conversations, and thrive on complex, high value deals rather than high volume transactional sales.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Operate as a full cycle sales consultant, engaging technically experienced prospects, qualifying their goals, and guiding them to a decision
  • Hold credible, informed conversations about technical topics relevant to our advanced courses, without needing to defer every technical question elsewhere
  • Present and articulate TripleTen's value proposition for career advancement and skill deepening, tailored to an audience that already has industry experience
  • Work closely with sales leadership to close complex, higher ticket deals and consistently meet or exceed quota
  • Work closely with marketing to refine messaging and positioning for this more experienced audience
  • Maintain accurate documentation of leads and pipeline progress using HubSpot
  • Bring consultative rigor and technical credibility to a team built around trust and expertise

﻿Weekly Schedule:

11:00 AM - 8:00 PM (EST) Monday to Thursday, 9:00 AM (EST) - 6:00 PM (EST) rotating Friday or Saturday

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 3+ years closing high-ticket deals ($5k+) yourself, full cycle — B2B SaaS, tech sales, EdTech or other complex products
  • Strong discovery skills - able to diagnose a prospect's goals and gaps before pitching, not lead with a script.
  • Fluent English (C1 or above)
  • Technical background or experience selling to technical buyers is a plus, not a requirement

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Base Compensation: $2,000/month + uncapped commission based on hitting monthly cash-in quota. Total monthly earnings typically range from $6,000 to $8,000+ for consistent performers, with no cap on top results.
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom — to make working together seamless
  • Growth. Our product is expanding quickly, so it's a great time to get on board and challenge yourself
  • Internationally distributed team. Exceptional teammates, who love what they do

  • Hands-on experience designing AI content systems, including prompt libraries, context engineering, source-of-truth repositories, multi-step/agentic workflows, and human review gates.
  • Strong range across content formats; experience limited mainly to blogs or SEO content is not sufficient.
  • Native-equivalent written English and the ability to work autonomously with senior stakeholders in a distributed team.

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for an experienced B2B Content Manager to own our global content strategy and build an AI-assisted content operation from the ground up. You’ll combine hands-on content creation for enterprise audiences with designing scalable AI workflows and quality controls.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Own and develop the global B2B content strategy, aligning content with enterprise audiences, buying committees, positioning, and pipeline goals.
  • Create high-quality content across formats, including website and landing page copy, paid advertising, whitepapers, case studies, thought leadership, social, video scripts, and sales enablement materials.
  • Build and operate an AI-assisted content production system, including prompt libraries, context engineering, source-of-truth repositories, workflows, and human review gates.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, and regional Marketing teams to turn complex AI products and customer needs into clear, compelling enterprise messaging.
  • Own editorial quality and consistency across all B2B content, continuously improving content based on performance data and new AI capabilities.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 6+ years of experience in B2B content marketing, including 3+ years creating content for technical or enterprise audiences with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Strong portfolio of personally written content, including whitepapers, case studies, website copy, and paid acquisition content.
  • Proven experience building and running AI-assisted content production in a real production environment, not just using consumer AI tools ad hoc.
  • Hands-on experience designing AI content systems, including prompt libraries, context engineering, source-of-truth repositories, multi-step/agentic workflows, and human review gates.
  • Strong range across content formats; experience limited mainly to blogs or SEO content is not sufficient.
  • Native-equivalent written English and the ability to work autonomously with senior stakeholders in a distributed team.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Remote, full-time collaboration;
  • Monthly Base Payment $4000 - $5000 gross pending aligned experience and skills;
  • Annual bonus system;
  • Digital office. We use modern digital tools like Miro, Notion, Slack, etc., to keep our teamwork smooth;
  • Have the freedom to work professionally. We trust your experience and don't believe in micromanaging;
  • Room to grow. Our product is expanding rapidly, so it's a great chance to join and challenge yourself;
  • Diverse and close-knit team. We're spread out across the world: Europe, Asia and Latin America.


We're excited to get to know you and work together!
