details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.


We are seeking a data-driven and strategic Senior User Acquisition Manager to lead our Google Ads efforts across the US region. Reporting to our Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for scaling high-budget campaigns and optimizing complex funnels to drive enrollment for our high-value tech programs.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Full channel P&L for Google Ads Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, and Shopping/feed-based formats where relevant.
  • Bidding and account architecture at scale — value-based bidding, tROAS/tCPA, portfolio strategies, budget pacing, and the account structure that makes them work rather than fight each other.
  • The signal layer. Offline conversion imports, enhanced conversions, server-side tracking, and CRM-to-Google feedback loops so smart bidding optimizes toward revenue and qualified leads, not top-of-funnel noise.
  • Geo expansion. Launch and scale new markets: keyword research in-language, localization QA, market-specific landing pages, budget allocation across a global portfolio.
  • Measurement and incrementality. Geo-lift tests, holdouts, MMM inputs, attribution disputes — and the judgment to know when platform-reported ROAS is lying to you.
  • Creative and landing page velocity. Ad copy testing at scale (including AI-assisted production), RSA asset management, and a continuous LP/CRO testing roadmap with design and web.
  • Competitive strategy. Brand defense, conquesting, auction insights, and pricing-pressure response.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 4+ years in paid search, with at least 2–3 years at senior/lead level owning a channel independently.
  • Global track record — non-negotiable. You've managed paid search across multiple regions (e.g., North America + EMEA + LATAM/APAC) and multiple languages, with documented results in each. Y
  • Meaningful budget scale. You've personally managed $100K+ / month budget or equivalent annual spend, and can talk credibly about what changes at scale versus what doesn't.
  • Deep technical fluency: Google Ads UI and Editor, scripts, bulk operations, Google Ads API or SA360, GA4, Looker/Tableau, and SQL comfortable enough to pull your own numbers without waiting on analytics.
  • Conversion tracking ownership. GTM, server-side tagging, offline conversion uploads, CRM integration (HubSpot/Salesforce or similar). You've debugged a broken conversion pipeline yourself.
  • Analytical rigor. You design tests with enough power to read, you know the difference between correlation and lift, and you'll say "this result isn't significant" out loud.
  • Fluent English, working comfortably in a distributed international team.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Competitive compensation.
  • Part-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
  • A close-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
  • All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

details.name: What you will do
details.value:

  • Read the whole funnel: CPL and lead volume are the beginning of the story, not the end. You track lead → SQL → sale.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• UA Expertise: 3+ years in User Acquisition, including personal ownership of Meta accounts at $50k+/month. Ownership means you set the strategy.
  • Relevant Recent Experience: In the last 2–3 years, products with a considered purchase and a long or offline conversion — education, B2B, fintech, real estate, healthcare or similar.
  • Analytical Rigor: Comfortable well past the ad account — lead quality, CAC, ROI, and reporting you build for yourself. You can name a change of yours that moved a down-funnel metric, and explain how you knew it worked.
  • Structured Thinking on Paper: Launch plans, test maps and post-mortems are a habit.
  • A Position You Can Defend: You've seen a problem nobody assigned to you, dug into the data, proposed a solution and carried it through. You argue with your manager when you think they're wrong — with evidence.
  • Creative Intuition: While you don't need to be a designer, you must have a deep understanding of visual hooks, messaging, and what drives engagement in the current Meta landscape.
  • Adaptability: A fast-paced, remote-first environment where you work independently and own your results.
  • Language Proficiency: Working proficiency in English (B2+ preferred).

details.name: Description
details.value:
Nebius Academy is a global AI education platform dedicated to empowering individuals and organizations to master artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI.

Nebius Academy combines deep technical expertise with a vision for AI-powered education, supporting both individuals aiming to upskill for new career paths and companies pursuing innovation at scale. Through a vibrant global community, Nebius Academy bridges the skills gap and accelerates the responsible adoption of AI, ensuring that both professionals and organizations are equipped to lead in an era of constant technological change.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Build and evolve our Internal Developer Platform, helping engineering teams move from merge request to production faster and more reliably.
  • Own and develop our monorepo, keeping applications, shared libraries, and infrastructure coherent as the codebase and engineering organization grow.
  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, including incremental builds, automated deployments, and tooling that makes shipping software simpler and faster.
  • Automate the creation and setup of new services, including infrastructure, Helm charts, alerts, dashboards, and deployment pipelines.
  • Build internal tools and automations that improve developer experience and engineering productivity across product teams.
  • Treat engineers as your users: identify what slows them down, gather requirements, and turn those problems into scalable platform solutions.
  • Measure and improve build times, deployment duration, performance, and reliability, fixing root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Codify engineering conventions through linting, type checks, CI gates, and automation instead of relying on manual processes.
  • Work hands-on across application code and infrastructure, using technologies such as Python, Go, AWS, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Postgres, Kafka, and Grafana.
  • Work closely with SRE, QA, and product engineering teams on reliability, observability, performance, and quality.
  • Make pragmatic architectural decisions and evaluate trade-offs around scalability, maintainability, developer experience, and delivery speed.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 5+ years of engineering experience. Python preferred; real depth in Java, C#, Kotlin or Go is a heavy plus. Ideally, you are comfortable with Python alongside at least one other backend language.
  • Understanding and production experience with Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, Docker, AWS and CI systems.
  • Deep understanding of product development — how teams plan, ship, maintain, and troubleshoot features.
  • A track record of building tooling and pipelines other engineers rely on, and real care for developer experience.
  • Performance work grounded in measurement — metrics, traces and query plans rather than intuition.
  • Architectural judgement in trade-offs rather than rules, avoiding both early overengineering and painted-in corners.
  • Comfort in a large shared repository, and clarity about its trade-offs.
  • Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy — clarify ambiguous requirements, identify what needs to be done, propose solutions, and take ownership through implementation rather than relying on detailed task specifications.
  • Agile ways of working, and real investment in team processes, mentoring, and collective growth.
  • A strong learning and team mindset: curiosity, willingness to grow beyond your current area of expertise, and readiness to contribute where it creates the most value for the team.
  • Fluent Russian, and English at B2 level or above.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• A supportive and proactive work environment.
  • Competitive compensation: 5000-7000 USD Gross per month
  • Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
  • Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
  • Tangible results measured by student success.

details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.


We are seeking a data-driven and strategic Senior User Acquisition Manager to lead our Meta Ads efforts across the US region. Reporting to our Marketing Lead, you will be responsible for scaling high-budget campaigns and optimizing complex funnels to drive enrollment for our high-value tech programs.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Own the budget and paid strategy for the advanced programs line — roughly $200K/month today, scaling several times over by year-end.
  • Run Meta and Google (YouTube included) as core volume channels; open LinkedIn and run experiments in Reddit and Twitter.
  • Own campaign and ad-set architecture, plus the keep-or-kill calls: small batches, a data threshold before deciding, weekly cadence, an honest decision log.
  • Brief the content producer and judge the output on metrics — you don't write scripts or build pages, creatives, or dashboards yourself.
  • Own traffic quality rather than cost per lead: read sales call transcripts, see who actually shows up, and influence target-audience share.
  • Own attribution and conversion events — pixel and event setup, separate buying infrastructure, and reconciling the ad account against CRM and BI.
  • Take each new program in the line into your channels with its own funnel and targets, adding sales rather than redistributing share.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 4+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition, with hands-on account work at real budgets in expensive markets in the last year or two.
  • You have experience with expensive acquisition and long, multi-step funnels — education, B2B, fintech, high-ticket services — in the last two to three years, not earlier in your resume.
  • Comfort with narrow audiences and thin data, where judgment fills the gap statistics won't, and a clear answer to what "enough delivery to decide" means.
  • You know full-funnel economics — CAC, contribution, cohorts, lead-to-call, call-to-sale — and read CRM and BI data alongside the ad account.
  • Attribution, conversion events, pixels, and tracking QA are things you've owned, not things someone did for you.
  • Strong craft: A/B testing offers and creatives, and briefs a production team can run with.
  • AI is already how you work — Claude, call-analysis tools, MCP connectors, choosing the right model, catching hallucinations.
  • Full professional English level.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Competitive compensation.
  • Full-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
  • A close-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
  • All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

details.name: Description
details.value:
🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for an autonomous, growth-minded Social Media Content Manager to take 100% ownership of our US Instagram presence (along with Threads & LinkedIn). In this role, you won't just post content - you’ll own the entire strategy: revamping our profile storefront for a tech-savvy audience and building a seamless bridge between high-performing Meta Ads and our profile content to turn visitors into buyers.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Own the Social Media Channels: Take full end-to-end ownership of our Instagram account, extending distribution to Threads and LinkedIn to drive audience engagement in the US market.
  • Repackage the Instagram Storefront: Revamp profile highlights, pinned posts, and top-of-feed content to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.
  • Bridge Ads to Profile: Sync social content with active Meta Ad campaigns, ensuring users landing from ads see consistent messaging, proof points, and value promises that drive conversions.
  • Build & Execute the Content Strategy: Create and manage a structured content calendar featuring high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, interactive posts, and compelling copy).
  • Direct Creative Production: Set clear briefs and collaborate seamlessly with in-house copywriters, graphic designers, and SEO managers to produce high-quality assets.
  • Track & Optimize Metrics: Monitor core engagement metrics (saves, shares, reach, ER) and continuously iterate on content tactics based on data and audience feedback.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Channel Ownership: Take full end-to-end ownership of the Instagram account (with cross-posting to Threads and LinkedIn), driving content strategy, execution, and engagement for our US audience.
  • Profile Packaging & Value Proposition: Re-pack and maintain the Instagram storefront (Highlights, pinned posts, and top feed) to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.
  • Ad-to-Profile Funnel Matching: Align social content with active performance marketing campaigns (Meta Ads) to ensure a seamless post-click user journey that reinforces ad promises and drives conversion.
  • Content Planning & Execution: Develop and manage a consistent content calendar tailored to a tech-savvy, English-speaking audience, focusing on high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, copy).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Brief and direct internal team members (copywriters, graphic designers, SEO managers) and external creative vendors (motion designers) to produce high-quality assets.
  • Performance Tracking: Monitor key social metrics (engagement rate, saves, shares, reach) and iterate on content strategy based on data and audience feedback.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• 100% Remote: Freedom to work from anywhere (Europe, LATAM, Georgia, Serbia, etc.)
  • Full Ownership & Creative Freedom: End-to-end ownership of the social media channels with room to test new ideas, experiment with formats, and directly influence conversion metrics.
  • Strong Team Support: Dedicated internal resources at your disposal, including graphic designers, copywriters, and SEO managers to help execute your vision.
  • International Impact: Hands-on experience scaling social channels for a fast-growing EdTech product in the US market.
  • Dynamic Startup Environment: Fast-paced, low-bureaucracy environment with direct access to decision-makers and modern AI/marketing tools.

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is an award-winning online school among technology bootcamps. Our mission is to help people change their lives and succeed in technology. We offer flexibility in studies, career mentoring, resume and portfolio preparation, and we guarantee employment after the course. Our employability rate among graduates is 87% across our Full Stack Development, Quality Assurance (QA) and Data Analytics programs.

We are looking for an Onboarding Specialist for our Latin America team. You will guide new students from the moment they pay until they start their first sprint, keep them motivated, answer their doubts, and remove anything standing between them and the first lesson. This is not a sales role, but it needs a salesperson's skills: you listen, you handle objections and you close on a next step.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Contact every new student within the agreed timeframes, run the welcome call and make sure their payment, access and tools are ready before the start.
  • Understand each student's goal and situation and connect the program to it, so they start motivated and know what to do first.
  • Handle doubts, objections and early cancellation requests yourself: offer alternatives and find the reason to continue.
  • Follow up proactively with students who go silent, miss the start or hit a blocker in the first days.
  • Record every interaction and outcome in HubSpot, and share what you learn from students with the team.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• 1+ years in sales, retention, account management or customer service with a commercial component, in B2C (education, fintech, subscriptions or similar).
  • You handle objections calmly and can show results in persuading customers to stay or to buy.
  • Results-oriented: you are measured by how many of your students start, not by how many calls you make.
  • Fluent Spanish and English at B1 level or above.
  • Organized and autonomous: many students in parallel, tight deadlines, accurate CRM records.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with HubSpot, Slack, Discord or similar tools.
  • EdTech or call-center background.

No technical background needed — we will teach you our programs and scripts.

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• 100% remote full-time collaboration.
  • 600 USD gross per month + monthly bonus based on KPIs.
  • Schedule: 5/2, shifts with rotational weekend coverage (weekend availability is important).
  • Digital office: Slack, Notion, Zoom, HubSpot, HiBob.
  • Training on our onboarding scripts and call quality, and a clear path to Senior Onboarding, Retention or Student Success roles.
  • Friendly and professional team across the US and Latin America.

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is an internationally recognized tech school on a mission to help people build successful careers in technology, regardless of their starting point. As we continue to grow in Brazil, we’re looking for talented people who want to make a real impact in students’ lives while working in a global, innovative, and fast-paced environment.

As a Student Success Manager, you’ll play a key role in this mission by supporting students throughout their learning journey. You’ll help keep them engaged, progressing academically, and connected to the support they need, while contributing to retention and an overall positive student experience. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working closely with people, solving problems, and helping students stay on track toward their goals.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Manage and support Brazilian student cohorts throughout the full learning journey.
  • Monitor student engagement, academic progress, graduation indicators, and churn risks.
  • Proactively identify at-risk students and develop retention and recovery plans.
  • Conduct 1:1 student support and provide guidance regarding study plans, deadlines, pauses, cohort changes, and other academic matters.
  • Handle complex student cases, escalations, complaints, and retention situations with an empathetic and solution-oriented approach.
  • Collaborate with tutors, instructors, onboarding, retention, finance, support, and other internal teams to resolve student issues.
  • Coordinate cohort operations, including deadlines, communications, webinars, academic events, and student follow-ups.
  • Track and analyze Student Experience KPIs such as graduation, churn, active students, engagement, and retention.
  • Use CRM, ticketing, reporting, and internal systems to document cases, monitor student status, and support data-driven decisions.
  • Identify recurring student issues and propose improvements to processes, communication, and the overall student experience.

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
• Native or fluent Portuguese.

details.name: Description
details.value:
TripleTen is an online teaching platform that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.


🚀 Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.


What is our goal?

We are continuously looking for experienced UX/UI Design professionals who want to support and guide our students on their path to becoming professional developers. This is a full-time teaching role with an expectation of 40 hours per week. The schedule can be flexible, but you must be consistently available to support students throughout their learning journey.


How to apply?

Apply here. We review applications on a rolling basis and invite selected candidates to record an introductory video where you answer a few questions, and complete a short technical test task.

If a vacancy is available, we will assign it to you right away; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed task on file for future opportunities.

📌 Please submit your CV in English.

details.name: What you will do
details.value:
• Host regular live Q&A sessions to help students unblock and progress confidently
  • Offer personalized support through 1:1 video calls to answer questions and guide assignments
  • Occasionally respond to student questions via direct messages
  • Lead live lessons on core program topics and industry-relevant skills
  • Share your professional insights and best practices to support the learning community
  • Review student projects and provide feedback based on program standards
  • Write clear, actionable feedback to help students improve and meet expectations
  • Support students in text by explaining concepts, troubleshooting code, and clarifying project or review questions

details.name: Requirements
details.value:
We require over 3 years of hands-on experience in UX/UI Design, with expertise in:

  • Design Thinking and Visual Design: Proven proficiency in applying user-centered design principles, creating visually appealing and functional designs, and adjusting them based on user needs and feedback.
  • UX Research and Usability Testing: Skilled in conducting and analyzing user interviews, usability tests, and contextual inquiries to gather insights that inform design decisions.
  • Prototyping and Interaction Design: Proficient with tools like Figma, Sketch, or InVision for wireframing, interactive prototyping, and design iteration.
  • UI Design Systems and Accessibility: Knowledgeable in building scalable design systems and adhering to accessibility guidelines to ensure usability for diverse users.
  • Ability to explain complex topics in understandable terms.
  • Patience and empathy toward students.

Nice to have:

  • Teaching or tutoring experience.
  • Have your own experience as a student online, and the desire to help create the best place in the world to study UX/UI Design!

details.name: What we can offer you
details.value:
• Flexible & remote collaboration.
  • Training in mentoring and communication techniques.
  • A schedule that’s convenient for you. There isn’t a focus on micromanaging.
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc. — to make working together seamless.
  • A diverse and tight-knit team which is spread out across the US and LatAm, and loves what it does!
  • Growth — our product is growing rapidly, so it’s an excellent time to join us and challenge yourself professionally.
  • Meaningful impact — share your knowledge and support others as they launch new careers in tech.


We're excited to get to know you and collaborate! ?
